jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

jobs.description:
En Veriforce, ayudamos a las empresas de industrias de alto riesgo a mantener seguros y en cumplimiento normativo a sus trabajadores, lugares de trabajo y cadenas de suministro. Como líder mundial en la gestión de riesgos de contratistas y cadenas de suministro, nuestra plataforma SaaS simplifica la incorporación de contratistas, la gestión de credenciales y el cumplimiento, al tiempo que proporciona potentes análisis e información estratégica. Más allá del software, ofrecemos soporte experto, capacitación y consultoría para que nuestros clientes puedan operar con confianza. Juntos, hacemos que los lugares de trabajo sean más seguros cada día.

El Ejecutivo de Cuentas Empresariales es responsable de impulsar el crecimiento de nuevos negocios ayudando a organizaciones grandes y complejas a mejorar el cumplimiento de los contratistas, la cualificación de la fuerza laboral y el desempeño en materia de seguridad mediante las soluciones de Veriforce. Este puesto contribuye directamente al crecimiento de los ingresos, la adquisición de clientes y la misión de Veriforce de crear lugares de trabajo más seguros y en mayor conformidad con las normativas.

El Ejecutivo de Cuentas Empresariales gestiona oportunidades estratégicas que involucran múltiples unidades de negocio, partes interesadas de nivel ejecutivo, procesos formales de adquisiciones, revisiones legales y plazos de decisión prolongados. El éxito requiere habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo, una gestión disciplinada de oportunidades y la capacidad de generar consenso entre diversos grupos de partes interesadas. Mediante la planificación estratégica de cuentas, la interacción consultiva y una ejecución disciplinada, este puesto actúa como asesor de confianza al tiempo que posiciona a Veriforce como socio comercial a largo plazo.

Las cuentas empresariales son los clientes y prospectos más grandes y complejos de Veriforce, que normalmente operan en múltiples sitios y unidades de negocio, con poblaciones considerables de contratistas y funciones formales de adquisiciones. El puesto abarca un conjunto definido de cuentas designadas en los sectores de energía, servicios públicos, construcción industrial y manufactura, y trabaja junto con Customer Success, Solutions Consulting e Implementation para conseguir nuevos clientes y ampliar las relaciones existentes.

Lo que esto significa en el día a día:

  • Generación Estratégica de Ingresos – Alcanza la cuota anual asignada mientras mantiene una cobertura suficiente del pipeline para respaldar el crecimiento futuro.
  • Planificación de Cuentas Empresariales – Desarrolla y ejecuta planes integrales de cuentas que identifican iniciativas de negocio, influencia de las partes interesadas, prioridades organizacionales y oportunidades de crecimiento.
  • Gestión de Oportunidades Complejas – Lidera las oportunidades a través del descubrimiento, desarrollo del caso de negocio, alineación de soluciones, presentaciones ejecutivas, negociación, adquisiciones, revisión legal y formalización de contratos.
  • Participación de Partes Interesadas Ejecutivas – Establece relaciones a nivel ejecutivo que generan credibilidad, identifican prioridades estratégicas y hacen avanzar oportunidades complejas.
  • Expansión de Cuentas y Crecimiento a Largo Plazo – Identifica oportunidades para ampliar las relaciones, aumentar la adopción de soluciones y respaldar el crecimiento de los ingresos a largo plazo dentro de las cuentas empresariales.
  • Venta Consultiva de Soluciones – Desarrolla un conocimiento profundo de los objetivos del cliente, los desafíos operativos y los requisitos de cumplimiento para generar un valor empresarial medible.
  • Generación de Consenso y Estrategia de Negociación – Se desenvuelve en entornos complejos de partes interesadas e impulsa la alineación organizacional durante todo el proceso de compra.
  • Pronóstico y Gestión del CRM – Mantiene registros precisos de las oportunidades, fechas de cierre y categorías de pronóstico en Salesforce, y proporciona proyecciones de compromiso y potencial adicional que resisten un análisis detallado.
  • Colaboración Interfuncional – Colabora con Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Marketing, Product, Legal y Leadership para respaldar los resultados de los clientes.
  • Proceso de Ventas y Gobernanza de Acuerdos – Gestiona cada oportunidad a través del proceso de ventas y el estándar de calificación de Veriforce, mantiene un plan de cuenta para todas las oportunidades que superen un umbral definido y presenta posiciones respaldadas por evidencia y revisadas en la cadencia semanal de compromisos y pronósticos.
  • Disciplina Comercial – Vende conforme a los precios aprobados y los términos comerciales estándar, escala únicamente las excepciones genuinas a través de la vía de aprobación acordada y compromete gastos de viajes y clientes dentro del presupuesto y la autoridad aprobados.
  • Traspaso a Implementación – Transfiere los negocios cerrados a Customer Success e Implementation mediante el proceso de lanzamiento definido, con el alcance, los compromisos y las expectativas del cliente documentados y comprendidos.
  • Representación en el Mercado – Representa profesionalmente a Veriforce mediante reuniones con clientes, conferencias, eventos del sector y oportunidades de interacción estratégica.
Cómo se ve el éxito
  • Alcanza o supera de manera constante los objetivos asignados de ingresos y pipeline.
  • Desarrolla y mantiene un pipeline calificado capaz de respaldar el crecimiento de los ingresos a largo plazo y la precisión de los pronósticos.
  • Demuestra capacidad para calificar oportunidades complejas, asignar recursos de manera eficaz y priorizar las oportunidades con la mayor probabilidad de éxito.
  • Desarrolla relaciones de confianza a nivel ejecutivo que posicionan a Veriforce como socio estratégico.
  • Hace avanzar con éxito oportunidades complejas a través de ciclos de venta prolongados y procesos organizacionales de toma de decisiones.
  • Demuestra capacidades excepcionales de descubrimiento, presentación, negociación y planificación de cuentas.
  • Mantiene registros precisos y oportunos en el CRM que proporcionan visibilidad sobre el estado de las oportunidades y el desempeño del negocio.
  • Los planes de cuentas, registros de oportunidades y próximos pasos están lo suficientemente actualizados como para que un colega o líder pueda hacerse cargo de la cuenta sin necesidad de una sesión informativa.
  • Trabaja dentro de los procesos y la autoridad comercial de Veriforce, y cuenta con la confianza de Customer Success, Implementation y Legal para realizar un traspaso adecuado.

Lo que necesitarás para tener éxito:

  • Cinco o más años de experiencia en ventas B2B, incluidos al menos tres años vendiendo a cuentas empresariales o estratégicas con ciclos de decisión prolongados.
  • Título universitario de licenciatura o experiencia profesional equivalente.
  • Conocimiento práctico de Salesforce o de un CRM comparable, y de una metodología reconocida de calificación de ventas.
  • La experiencia en entornos industriales, de energía, servicios públicos o construcción es una ventaja.
  • Éxito demostrado en la gestión de oportunidades empresariales que involucran a múltiples partes interesadas, responsables de la toma de decisiones a nivel ejecutivo y ciclos de venta prolongados.
  • Alcanza de manera constante los objetivos de ingresos mediante la planificación estratégica de cuentas, el desarrollo del pipeline y la gestión de oportunidades.
  • Experiencia realizando reuniones de descubrimiento a nivel ejecutivo, presentaciones, revisiones de negocio y conversaciones basadas en el valor.
  • Genera consenso entre las partes interesadas de las áreas de negocio, operaciones, adquisiciones, asuntos legales y cumplimiento.
  • Desarrolla casos de negocio convincentes que comunican valor operativo, financiero y estratégico.
  • Mantiene una gestión disciplinada de los pronósticos y del pipeline, así como la precisión de los datos en el CRM.

What you’ll get in return:

¡Estas son solo algunas de las excelentes razones para unirte a nuestro equipo!
  • ¡Trabaja con un equipo global! Tenemos colegas y clientes en toda América del Norte y alrededor del mundo.
  • ¡Veriforce es un excelente lugar para trabajar! Nuestros líderes y miembros del equipo mencionan constantemente nuestra cultura como una de las principales razones por las que es un excelente lugar para desarrollar una carrera profesional.
La compensación incluye un salario base competitivo más remuneración variable, junto con todas las prestaciones de ley, vacaciones pagadas y prima vacacional, seguridad social del IMSS, aportaciones al INFONAVIT para vivienda y retiro, y un apoyo para trabajar desde casa.

Todas las ofertas de empleo estarán sujetas a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes. Adopción de la IA en Veriforce Como parte de nuestro compromiso con la innovación y la mejora continua, estamos incorporando activamente herramientas de IA y formas de trabajo basadas en IA en toda la empresa. Animamos a todos los empleados a explorar cómo la IA puede mejorar la productividad, mejorar la toma de decisiones, agilizar los procesos y crear valor para nuestros clientes.

La adopción y el uso eficaces de la IA formarán parte de las expectativas del puesto y se tendrán en cuenta como parte de las revisiones periódicas de objetivos y las conversaciones sobre el desempeño. Job Title: Business Development Specialist – IQVIA Language Solutions

Business Development Specialist – IQVIA Language Solutions


Europe-based | Business Development | Life Sciences & Healthcare


The opportunity


IQVIA Language Solutions is building the multilingual operating layer for global life sciences—bringing together healthcare intelligence, AI-enabled workflows, specialist human expertise and the reach of IQVIA. We are moving beyond traditional translation to help customers manage critical content safely and efficiently across clinical, regulatory, safety, patient and commercial workflows.

Join a growing, entrepreneurial commercial team and build your career in an industry where language, technology and healthcare come together. With IQVIA’s credibility, global reach and scientific expertise behind you, you will learn how to open new relationships, understand customer needs and help shape solutions that make a meaningful difference.


As Business Development Specialist, you will be an energetic and proactive member of the commercial team, focused on creating new opportunities across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO and healthcare customers. You will research target accounts, connect with prospective customers, qualify interest and support opportunities as they progress through the sales process. This is a hands-on role for someone who is curious, motivated and excited to learn.


What you will do


  • Research target companies, market segments and key stakeholders to identify potential opportunities.
  • Generate interest through thoughtful outbound outreach, campaigns, networking and follow-up.
  • Qualify prospective customers by learning about their needs, priorities and current approach to multilingual content.
  • Build and maintain an active pipeline, keeping customer and opportunity information accurate in the CRM.
  • Schedule and support introductory meetings, discovery discussions, presentations and follow-up activities.
  • Work with senior business development colleagues to progress qualified opportunities through the sales process.
  • Help prepare account plans, proposals, presentations and other customer-facing materials.
  • Develop a strong understanding of IQVIA Language Solutions, our customers and the life sciences workflows we support.
  • Collaborate with Presales, Account Management, Marketing, Delivery and other IQVIA teams to create a positive customer experience.
  • Bring energy, ideas and market feedback to a fast-evolving commercial team.

What success looks like


  • A growing pipeline of well-researched, qualified opportunities.
  • Consistent prospecting activity that creates meetings and meaningful customer conversations.
  • Accurate CRM records, organized follow-up and dependable support for the wider commercial team.
  • Increasing confidence in communicating IQVIA Language Solutions’ value to life sciences customers.

What you bring


  • Early-career experience in business development, sales, account management, customer service or another commercial role; experience in healthcare, life sciences, language services, localization or B2B services is helpful but not essential.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for building relationships, starting conversations and creating new business opportunities.
  • Curiosity about healthcare, languages, technology and AI, with a strong desire to learn.
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive, organized approach and the persistence to follow through.
  • Comfort working toward activity goals and commercial targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions, seek feedback and learn from experienced colleagues.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools is helpful.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage.

Why join IQVIA Language Solutions?


You will join at a pivotal point: the team is growing its commercial organization, expanding into new life sciences workflows and building a more connected, technology-enabled portfolio. You will receive exposure to experienced commercial and delivery colleagues, a broad range of customers and the scale and capabilities of IQVIA—all while developing practical skills in prospecting, consultative selling and life sciences.

If you are energetic, curious and excited by the opportunity to build relationships, learn quickly and contribute to a growing business with global reach, we would like to hear from you.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview

We are building a dedicated finance presence inside each of our business divisions, and this role is one of them. As Director, Operational Finance, you will be the embedded finance partner to a division’s CEO and leadership team: the person who knows the division’s numbers, helps leaders make better decisions with them, and makes sure what happens in the division is reflected accurately in company-wide planning.

You will report to the SVP of Finance, with a dotted-line relationship with your division’s CEO & the Head of FP&A, and you will be working alongside the Corporate Finance team that runs central processes. This is an individual contributor role with significant visibility and a clear path to growth within the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Partner with divisional leadership. Serve as the primary corporate finance and financial operations contact for your assigned division, working closely with the division CEO and the division executive team.
  • Drive consistency across divisions. Translate corporate FP&A reporting standards into division-specific execution, so that definitions and metrics (for example, bookings standardization, ARR-related metrics, and margin expansion) are applied the same way in every division.
  • Shape the plan. Bring divisional context, assumptions, and priorities into the annual budget run by Corporate Finance, and keep the division aligned with company-wide planning cycles.
  • Assist with forecasting. Assist division leadership on forecasting updates, performance tracking, and operational improvement. Act as financial chief of staff to the division CEO while staying closely aligned with Corporate Finance and overall company goals.
  • Flag risks early. Identify and escalate critical items, risks, and variances across bookings, retention, and costs to both divisional leadership and the central FP&A organization and support the work to resolve them.
  • Find the efficiencies. Identify and drive operational efficiencies and develop topline cost-savings and upside ideas in partnership with divisional leaders.
  • Own adjustment tracking. Own tracking of below-the-line (BTL) adjustment realization for your division, and report progress to Corporate Finance to support lender and board reporting.
  • Support the close and reporting cycle. Provide divisional input to the monthly and quarterly close, perform variance analysis, and prepare divisional commentary for management and board reporting. Deliver ad hoc analysis for division and corporate leadership as needs arise.
  • Partner Across the Organization. In addition to working with finance, partner with and influence other shared services roles such as Deal Desk, Operations, AR, Sales Operations, and Sales Compensation to drive the division forward and reduce friction.
  • Support M&A. Lead synergy identification and tracking for acquisitions that land in your division and provide divisional input to Corporate Finance on diligence and integration into company financials.

Requirements & Skills:

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, business finance, or finance partnering, including time in a SaaS business.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics, including ARR, bookings, retention, and margin, and the ability to explain what is driving them.
  • Strong financial modeling and variance analysis skills, with the judgment to know which numbers matter to an executive audience.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior business leaders, such as a CEO, GM, or head of sales, and influencing without direct authority.
  • Superior written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn analysis into recommendations and to use numbers to tell a story.
  • Experience in a private-equity-backed company, including lender or sponsor reporting.
  • Experience with M&A, including synergy tracking or post-acquisition integration.
  • Experience with a modern planning platform (Pigment preferred) or similar tools such as Adaptive, Anaplan, or Planful.
  • Experience with a multi-product or multi-entity software business.

Education:

As our retailer relationships scale and the complexity of our business deepens, we need someone who can turn that data into decisions — not just reports. About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

Contract to cash

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises

  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.title: YouTube Script Writer
jobs.excerpt: RoleCreate YouTube scripts that transform healthcare expertise into videos patients actually choose to watch.
jobs.description:
Role

Create YouTube scripts that transform healthcare expertise into videos patients actually choose to watch.

You'll write for doctors, surgeons, dentists and other health professionals, taking their expertise, perspectives and source material and turning it into compelling 6 to 10-minute YouTube videos that educate, build trust and keep viewers watching.

You won't be responsible for leading client strategy or conducting expert interviews. You'll be given the core ingredients for each video, including the topic, angle, source material and practitioner insights.

Your job is to turn those ingredients into an excellent script.

This isn't blogging, SEO writing or summarizing information into video format. You need to understand what makes someone click, what keeps them watching, when to reveal information, what to cut and how to make complex health information sound natural when spoken.

We need someone who writes for the ear, not the eye.

Every sentence should make the next sentence easier to keep listening to.

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor

This is a long-term contractor opportunity with a substantial and consistent workload. We expect this to be a significant professional commitment, although we're open to both full-time and part-time arrangements for the right person.

As an independent contractor, you'll determine when and where you work and manage your own schedule. This role does not include employee benefits.

We care about the quality and consistency of your work, your ability to meet agreed-upon deadlines, and your responsiveness to the team, not the specific hours you keep. You'll need to be available for occasional scheduled team meetings, but outside of those commitments, you'll have flexibility in how you structure your work.

Results

1. Every script earns attention

Scripts quickly deliver on the promise of the title while creating enough curiosity and tension to keep the viewer watching throughout.

2. Clients sound like themselves

Scripts capture the practitioner's ideas, language and point of view rather than sounding like generic health content or unedited AI output.

3. Complex health topics become easy to understand

Medical concepts are translated into clear, conversational language without losing important nuance or accuracy.

4. Scripts are ready to record

Scripts require minimal rewriting and feel natural when spoken aloud.

5. Every draft gets better

Feedback is applied quickly and consistently so the same writing problems don't need to be corrected repeatedly.

Responsibilities

Script Writing

Write 6 to 10 minute YouTube outlines & scripts that:

  • Hook the viewer quickly
  • Create a clear bridge between the title and opening
  • Maintain curiosity with open loops and delayed reveals
  • Build tension without manufacturing false drama
  • Explain complex medical topics simply
  • Apply direct-response principles to educational content
  • Sound conversational and natural when spoken
  • Capture the individual practitioner's voice
  • Avoid unnecessary jargon and explanation
  • Maintain momentum throughout the video
  • Deliver satisfying payoffs on the promise made by the title

Research & Source Material

Work from client interviews, intake forms, research and other source material to:

  • Identify the strongest ideas and insights
  • Understand the practitioner's actual perspective
  • Pull out useful examples, stories and explanations
  • Verify unfamiliar concepts when necessary
  • Distinguish genuinely interesting information from background information
  • Preserve medical accuracy while simplifying complexity

You should be comfortable entering an unfamiliar health topic and getting up to speed quickly.

Editing

Strong writing is often created by removing more than you add.

Edit ruthlessly for:

  • Repetition
  • Obvious statements
  • Weak examples
  • Unnecessary context
  • Jargon
  • Filler
  • Tangents
  • Awkward transitions
  • Overexplaining
  • Anything that slows the video down without adding understanding or interest

You should be able to look at a mediocre draft, quickly identify why it isn't working and make it substantially better.

Collaboration & Feedback

Work closely with our messaging team to improve scripts.

You'll be expected to:

  • Receive and implement editorial feedback
  • Explain your writing decisions when needed
  • Flag weak source material, missing information or problems with an assigned angle
  • Ask questions rather than inventing information
  • Learn from edits and apply those lessons to future scripts
  • Maintain a consistent standard across multiple client voices

Requirements

Exceptional Conversational Writing

You naturally write the way people speak.

Your scripts sound effortless when read aloud and can be adapted to reflect different clients' personalities and speaking styles.

You understand that a technically correct sentence can still sound unnatural when spoken.

Strong Healthcare Background

You have meaningful experience writing about, working in or communicating health and medical topics.

You don't need to be a clinician, but medical terminology and complex health concepts shouldn't intimidate you.

YouTube Writing Instincts

You understand that YouTube writing is fundamentally different from articles, blogs or traditional educational content.

You understand:

  • Viewer psychology
  • Hooks
  • Curiosity gaps
  • Open loops
  • Pacing
  • Escalating stakes
  • Delayed reveals
  • The secret code is HP2026
  • Payoffs
  • The relationship between a title and the opening of a video

You know when to answer a question and when to hold information long enough to maintain interest without becoming manipulative or frustrating.

Editorial Judgment

You can tell the difference between writing that is technically fine and writing that is actually compelling.

When reviewing a script, you naturally notice things like:

  • The opening takes too long to get to the point
  • The script doesn't properly deliver on the title
  • An answer is revealed too early
  • A section repeats something the viewer already understands

You don't need someone else to point these things out before you see them.

AI Fluency and Editorial Control

You use AI to accelerate research, ideation, organization and early drafts without outsourcing your judgment to it.

You know how to direct, challenge and refine AI-generated work.

Every final script must feel original, specific, conversational and human.

You are able to identify and remove common signs of weak AI-generated writing, including:

  • Generic phrasing
  • Predictable sentence patterns
  • Information that sounds important but says very little

AI may support the process. It cannot replace thinking.

Salary: $5,000-$7,000/mo

jobs.description:
Chart Desktop Management LPN

Department: Clinical Operations

Reports To: Nurse Manager

Location: Remote

Employment Status: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Hourly, Nonexempt

Position Summary

The Chart Desktop Management LPN is a full-time, remote clinical support position responsible for the daily ownership, monitoring, management, follow-up, and timely closure of assigned AthenaOne provider staff buckets and clinical desktop work across designated providers and care teams.

The position serves as a centralized clinical resource for provider-directed results, patient communications, portal messages, referrals, orders, clinical documents, follow-up needs, and other work routed to assigned provider staff buckets. The LPN prioritizes work according to clinical urgency, ensures time-sensitive items are addressed appropriately, tracks unresolved items through completion, and escalates concerns in accordance with provider direction, organizational policies, established workflows, and LPN scope of practice.

This is a newly created position. The responsibilities, workflows, performance expectations, and processes associated with the role will continue to be developed and refined with input from the employee selected for the position. The employee will be expected to actively participate in establishing effective workflows, identifying barriers, and recommending improvements as the role evolves.

The Chart Desktop Management LPN works collaboratively with the Nurse Manager, providers, and on-site clinical teams, allowing on-site staff to remain focused on direct patient care and efficient clinic flow.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Maintains primary responsibility and accountability for assigned AthenaOne provider staff buckets and clinical desktop work during scheduled work hours.
  • Continuously monitors assigned work queues and prioritizes items according to clinical urgency, patient-safety considerations, established timelines, provider direction, and organizational workflows.
  • Reviews and manages clinical messages, provider-directed results, patient communications, portal messages, incoming clinical documents, referrals, orders, and other work routed to assigned provider staff buckets.
  • Completes appropriate follow-up or routes items to the provider, registered nurse, triage team, or another appropriate team member when additional review, nursing assessment, direction, or action is required.
  • Follows established protocols for abnormal or critical results, promptly escalating findings to the appropriate licensed provider or registered nurse and confirming that timely follow-up occurs.
  • Communicates provider-directed test results, care instructions, follow-up testing, referrals, and other clinical information to patients in accordance with provider direction, approved protocols, organizational policy, and LPN scope of practice.
  • Documents patient outreach, clinical communications, provider instructions, unsuccessful contact attempts, and follow-up actions accurately and promptly in the electronic health record.
  • Tracks unresolved, pending, overdue, aging, or incomplete clinical items through completion and performs the follow-up or escalation necessary to reduce the risk of missed or delayed care.
  • Recognizes patient messages involving new or worsening symptoms or other concerns requiring nursing assessment and routes those messages to the established triage workflow.
  • Immediately escalates urgent or potentially emergent concerns to an available provider, registered nurse, clinical leader, or emergency service in accordance with organizational protocols.
  • Does not independently perform routine clinical triage. Triage activities may only be performed when permitted by LPN scope of practice, organizational policy, approved protocols, and appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Coordinates provider-directed follow-up related to referrals, specialist recommendations, laboratory testing, diagnostic imaging, hospital or emergency department records, and other continuity-of-care needs.
  • Reviews and follows up on referral- and order-related desktop items to support timely processing, patient communication, and completion.
  • Provides patient education related to provider-directed care plans, testing, and follow-up recommendations within LPN scope of practice.
  • Maintains awareness of provider schedules, absences, and covering-provider arrangements to ensure time-sensitive information is directed to an available provider.
  • Collaborates with the Nurse Manager, providers, registered nurses, triage staff, referral staff, and on-site clinical teams to resolve clinical desktop work requiring additional information, assessment, direction, or follow-up.
  • Communicates significant backlogs, aging items, recurring routing concerns, barriers to completion, or patient-safety concerns to the Nurse Manager promptly.
  • Provides updates regarding the status of assigned provider staff buckets, including unresolved work, aging items, and issues affecting timely completion.
  • Participates in developing and refining the responsibilities, processes, and performance measures for this newly created position.
  • Identifies recurring workflow or routing problems and recommends improvements related to AthenaOne desktop management, message routing, clinical follow-up, and closure of outstanding items.
  • Maintains reliable availability, productivity, and responsiveness throughout assigned remote work hours.
  • Protects patient confidentiality and complies with HIPAA, organizational privacy and security requirements, and remote-work expectations.
  • Uses only organization-approved equipment, systems, communication methods, and secure remote-access processes.
  • Follows all applicable agency, state, and federal policies, procedures, professional standards, and regulatory requirements.

Role Boundaries

  • This position is accountable for the active management and timely resolution of assigned provider staff buckets, not solely the observation or forwarding of desktop work.
  • Routine prescription refill processing is not an expected responsibility of this position. Refill requests must be routed and managed according to the organization’s established refill workflow.
  • Routine clinical triage is not a primary responsibility of this position. Messages requiring triage must be directed to the established triage workflow.
  • The LPN may not independently diagnose, prescribe, modify treatment plans, interpret results beyond provider direction or approved protocols, or provide instructions outside LPN scope of practice.
  • Matters requiring registered nursing assessment, provider judgment, or authorization must be escalated to the appropriate clinician.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current, unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse license valid in the State of New Hampshire.
  • Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program.
  • Minimum of [two] years of clinical nursing experience preferred.
  • Experience using an electronic health record system.
  • Ability to recognize urgent, emergent, abnormal, or time-sensitive concerns and escalate them appropriately.
  • Strong clinical documentation, organization, communication, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to independently organize and manage a high volume of electronic clinical work involving multiple providers and care teams.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in ambulatory care, primary care, community health, or a federally qualified health center.
  • Previous experience with AthenaOne.
  • Experience managing provider desktops, clinical inboxes, patient messages, results, referrals, or orders.
  • Experience supporting multiple providers or clinical care teams.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of professional LPN standards and scope of practice.
  • Ability to work within established protocols, provider direction, and appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Ability to distinguish routine clinical work from matters requiring registered nursing assessment, provider review, formal triage, or immediate escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, timely documentation.
  • Ability to monitor multiple work queues and track assigned items through final resolution.
  • Ability to recognize workflow breakdowns, recurring routing problems, and risks associated with unresolved clinical work.
  • Strong written, verbal, telephone, and electronic communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining accessible, responsive, and accountable to the Nurse Manager.
  • Willingness to help develop, test, and improve workflows for a newly established position.
  • Proficiency with computers, electronic health records, secure messaging, Microsoft applications, and remote communication platforms.

Remote-Work Requirements

  • Maintains a private, secure, and HIPAA-compliant workspace.
  • Maintains reliable high-speed internet access sufficient to support the organization’s electronic health record and communication systems.
  • Remains actively available and responsive during assigned work hours.
  • Complies with organizational requirements for remote access, information security, productivity, attendance, and communication.
  • Reports technology, access, workflow, or connectivity concerns promptly.
  • Understands that remote-work arrangements may be modified based on organizational needs, performance, security requirements, or operational considerations.

Performance Expectations

Successful performance includes:

  • Consistent daily ownership and management of assigned provider staff buckets.
  • Timely response to and closure of assigned clinical desktop work.
  • Appropriate identification and escalation of urgent, abnormal, or time-sensitive matters.
  • Accurate and timely documentation.
  • Effective tracking of unresolved and aging items through completion.
  • Prompt communication of backlogs, barriers, routing concerns, and patient-safety risks.
  • Compliance with role boundaries regarding prescription refills, triage, and LPN scope of practice.
  • Reliable availability, productivity, and responsiveness during assigned remote work hours.
  • Active participation in developing and improving the position’s workflows and performance standards.

Physical and Technical Requirements

  • Ability to remain seated and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate by telephone, video, secure messaging, and electronic health record systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret clinical documentation, electronic communications, and provider instructions.
  • Ability to perform repetitive keyboarding and computer-based tasks throughout the workday.

Acknowledgment

This job description summarizes the primary duties, responsibilities, and qualifications of the position. Because this is a newly created role, responsibilities and workflows may be adjusted as the position develops and organizational needs are evaluated. The employee selected for this position will be expected to participate in that development process.

  • Model and monitor performance guarantee exposure across the customer portfolio. Identify contracts at risk and provide accrual and reserve inputs to Accounting.

  • Establish reusable, version-controlled models and methodology documentation. Build actuarial understanding across Finance, Strategy, Commercial, and Clinical, and support audit and disclosure review.

You will independently set actuarial methodology and assess guarantee soundness, while partnering through existing governance for final pricing, contract terms, material risk acceptance, accounting conclusions, and external claims.

About you:

  • Strong experience using AI in analytical workflows, with clear validation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information.
  • Ability to present and defend methodology to payer actuaries and analysts, benefits consultants, and employer finance leaders.

You bring intellectual honesty, commercial judgment, and clear written communication. You can challenge an unsupported assumption constructively, distinguish evidence from uncertainty, and translate complex analysis into decisions without compromising methodological integrity.

Bonus Points for:

  • FSA and MAAA credentials rather than ASA alone.
  • Direct experience with GLP-1 and pharmacy trend economics, including specialty drug management.
  • Experience in Medicare or government markets, including Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, or risk adjustment methodologies.
  • Experience at a digital health or point solution vendor selling into employers and payers.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is looking for a Product Manager, B2B Customer Solutions to help build the products and workflows that bring Oura to organizations and partners around the world. You will own defined workstreams within our B2B offerings across corporate sales, health, and partner channels, and contribute to larger cross-functional initiatives that help businesses discover, purchase, implement, and grow with Oura.In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Operations, Legal, and Finance partners, with guidance and mentorship from senior members of the Commercial Solutions team. This is a great opportunity for a product manager who is ready to take on increasing ownership and wants to see their work drive measurable revenue and partner growth.

This role is open to U.S. candidates only. This role can be fully remote with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco, Chicago, or Boston, or a hybrid of remote/in-person if based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

What You Will Do:

  • Own products and workstreams within B2B Customer Solutions, from development through launch and ongoing iteration, with increasing independence. Lead an engineering squad through execution and manage stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Legal, Finance, and external partners. Manage the Commercial Solutions B2B product portfolio, keeping deliverables on track, and clearly communicating status and risks.
  • Develop the product strategy for your area, taking inputs from company objectives, the Commerce team, and your internal and external customers. Formulate informed opinions on our direction and strategy.
  • Ensure operational excellence across multiple active projects, setting standards, dashboards, and processes that keep teams aligned, unblocked, and accountable for outcomes. Set goals, identify metrics, implement instrumentation.

What you'll bring

Experience working directly with ERP systems and analytics platforms a plus.
  • Demonstrated executional experience on cross‑functional initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders, with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong business acumen and comfort working with commercial leaders; you can help prioritize efforts based on factors such as revenue impact, margin, scalability, operational efficiency, and strategic fit.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments, where data may be incomplete or changing, while still driving clarity, focus, and high‑quality decisions.

  • Experience working across different levels of scale, understanding that tools, processes, and product approaches must evolve as the company grows.
  • A high degree of ownership, proactivity, and integrity — you seek out context, ask sharp questions, and drive clarity without waiting to be told what to do.
  • Humor, grace, and patience to build on Oura’s core values in a fast paced, high growth environment.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr FLSA Status: ExemptSalary: 62K - 80K+Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year
