jobs.excerpt: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year Position Requirement: Full-Time FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Weymouth, Massachusetts Salary:135K - 160K+Work from Home!
jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Weymouth, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year

jobs.description:
React Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: React Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced React Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern enterprise web applications that power customer-facing digital platforms, internal business portals, and cloud-native SaaS solutions. This role focuses on building highly responsive, scalable, and maintainable Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React while integrating seamlessly with enterprise APIs, cloud services, and microservices-based backend platforms.
You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, cloud architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences across large-scale enterprise applications. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, a passion for clean architecture, and experience building production applications that serve thousands of concurrent users.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React and TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components following enterprise design system standards.
  • Develop responsive web applications optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
  • Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and cloud-native backend platforms.
  • Collaborate with UX designers to convert Figma or Adobe XD designs into pixel-perfect, accessible user interfaces.
  • Implement efficient client-side state management using Redux Toolkit, React Query, Zustand, or Context API.
  • Optimize application performance through lazy loading, code splitting, memoization, virtualization, and efficient rendering strategies.
  • Build secure authentication and authorization workflows using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Azure Active Directory, Okta, or Auth0.
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, SignalR, or Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  • Develop reusable custom hooks, utility libraries, and shared component packages.
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure application reliability and maintainability.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, browser compatibility challenges, and front-end performance bottlenecks.
  • Work closely with DevOps teams to automate deployments through CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional front-end software development experience.
  • Four or more years of hands-on React development experience building enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React 18+, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Hooks, Functional Components, Context API, Suspense, Error Boundaries, and component lifecycle.
  • Experience implementing state management using Redux Toolkit, Redux, Zustand, React Query (TanStack Query), or Context API.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
  • Experience working with authentication technologies including JWT, OAuth2, Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or OpenID Connect.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with modern front-end build tools including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, and Yarn.
  • Experience working with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience using CI/CD platforms including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and browser profiling tools.
  • Experience consuming backend services built with .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS platforms supporting thousands of concurrent users.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).
  • Experience implementing Micro Frontend architecture using Module Federation.
  • Knowledge of Progressive Web Applications (PWA) and offline-first web applications.
  • Experience integrating real-time communication using SignalR, WebSockets, or Firebase.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI (Swagger), GraphQL, Apollo Client, and API Gateway integrations.

jobs.description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Solutions Architecture - Advisor II

About your role:

As a Solutions Architecture, Advisor II, you will design and improve DevOps automation capabilities that support secure, scalable software delivery across platform engineering environments. You will work with engineers, architects, and cross-functional partners to build continuous integration and continuous delivery solutions, strengthen deployment reliability, and improve operational efficiency. Your work helps teams deliver resilient SaaS and enterprise platforms with greater consistency, speed, and control.


What you'll do:

  • Architect, build, and maintain secure continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms to support reliable software delivery.
  • Design and support automated deployment solutions using Kubernetes, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Argo CD, Helm, and Terraform
  • Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, Golang, or similar languages to improve operational efficiency, deployment consistency, and platform reliability.
  • Partner with platform engineering, development, security, and infrastructure teams to define technical requirements and implement scalable automation solutions.
  • Manage source control and pipeline workflows using Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, and related tools to support build quality, artifact management, and code validation.
  • Support integration and regression testing in Kubernetes environments to improve release quality and reduce deployment risk.
  • Monitor delivery workflows, identify process gaps, and implement improvements that strengthen compliance, security, and release performance in Agile environments.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or software automation roles supporting continuous integration and continuous delivery environments.
  • 6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting secure CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar platforms.
  • 6+ years of experience with Kubernetes automation and deployment management using Argo CD, Helm, Terraform, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), or equivalent container orchestration technologies.
  • 5+ years of experience developing automation solutions using Python, Bash, Golang, or similar programming and scripting languages.
  • Experience using Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, and related tools for source control, artifact management, code quality validation, and release workflows
  • Experience supporting integration and regression testing in Kubernetes-based environments and applying security and compliance controls in software delivery processes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience architecting complex GitLab CI/CD pipeline frameworks in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting zero-downtime database upgrades using Liquibase, Flyway, or similar database migration tools.
  • Experience in Software as a Service (SaaS) environments with compliance and security requirements.

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 45K-65K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Douglasville, GA

Salary:

45K - 65K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

As we expand our footprint in Canada, we’re looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to accelerate growth across one or more of our core vertical markets (e.g., Critical Infrastructure, Utilities, Data Centers, Logistics, Transportation, Oil & Gas, and related sectors).

This role is primarily focused on new business development—opening doors, creating demand, and converting early-stage conversations into qualified opportunities.   • Map customer organizations (stakeholders, decision structures, procurement pathways) and maintain accurate account intelligence

  • Partner with Sales to transition qualified opportunities and maintain momentum through the sales cycle
  • Build, manage, and maintain a healthy pipeline and a continuously expanding qualified customer database
  • Deliver professional product/solution overviews and presentations tailored to vertical use-cases
  • Provide market feedback on competitive activity, customer trends, and forces impacting strategy or tactical investment
  • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene (e.g., Salesforce) with accurate activity tracking, meeting notes, pipeline stages, and forecasts
  • Review progress regularly with Sales Leadership to ensure alignment to targets, KPIs, and priorities

What You Bring…

  • Proven success generating pipeline and new business in B2B / solution-based selling, ideally within security, critical infrastructure, energy environments, or adjacent technical domains
  • Familiarity with security/surveillance technologies, perimeter intrusion detection, access control, video, sensors, or integrated solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to open doors, build credibility, and develop relationships across multiple stakeholder levels
  • Strong business acumen and a track record of meeting activity and pipeline targets
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple pursuits while keeping commitments
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and reporting skills
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform
  • Willingness and ability to travel within Canada (and occasionally internationally as needed)

Nice to Have…

  • Experience selling into one or more of: Utilities, Data Centers, Transportation, Energy, Logistics
  • Established network within target verticals (end users, integrators, consultants)
  • Bilingual (English/French) is an asset

What We Offer…

  • A chance to grow business in high-impact, mission-critical environments
  • A collaborative, globally dispersed team that shares knowledge and supports execution
  • A culture of continuous improvement where innovation in products and processes is core
  • Competitive total rewards (salary, benefits, time off, and retirement savings programs—details shared during the process)

Inclusion & Accessibility

At Senstar, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace that values a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more innovative, and more competitive. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process, please let us know.

AI

We may use technology, including AI-based tools, to support our recruitment process (for example, to compare applications against job requirements or to summarize interview notes). All hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams, not by automated systems.

Salary: $140K to $165K OTE

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£100,000 - £133,000 + Benefits |

We’re looking for several Product Marketing Leads to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:

  • Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.
  • MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.
  • EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

You and your team will…

  • Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.
  • Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.
  • Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.
  • Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.
  • Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.
  • Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.

Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if:

  • You think beyond a single product. You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.
  • You own the hardest calls in your domain. You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.
  • You bring senior people with you. You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.
  • You're a player/coach. You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.

Your work will determine how fast the vertical can move, how safely teams can ship, and how confidently Rocket can execute one of its most consequential technology investments.

jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an experienced Transportation Logistics Specialist to manage the full scope of IT hardware logistics across the APAC region — including racks, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment. The role focuses on air freight and road transport across APAC, with a primary emphasis on shipments originating from or transiting through Taiwan, and deliveries into key APAC markets including Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, Malaysia, and additional destinations as the business expands.

You will be responsible for day-to-day execution of inbound and outbound shipments, RMA and RMS flows, cross-border customs coordination, and inter-facility transfers within the region. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role requiring deep knowledge of APAC freight markets, strong carrier and forwarder relationships, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Operations

  • Manage end-to-end transport of IT hardware — rack systems, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment — across all APAC lanes, including inbound shipments from Taiwan, inter-regional moves, and outbound flows as required.
  • Coordinate air freight and road transport scheduling, carrier and freight forwarder selection, and delivery execution to ensure on-time, damage-free arrival at APAC data center sites.
  • Handle all RMA and RMS shipments within the APAC region, including coordination with vendors, carriers, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely processing.
  • Manage equipment transfers between company warehouses and data center facilities across the region, optimising routes and minimising handling risk.
  • Maintain full visibility over active shipments across all APAC lanes and proactively resolve transit issues, delays, or exceptions.
  • Develop contingency plans and alternative routing strategies to ensure business continuity.
  • Manage time-critical air freight shipments where required, including carrier selection, booking, and end-to-end tracking to ensure expedited delivery of hardware.

Coordination & Documentation

  • Coordinate closely with data center operations teams across APAC to support staging, buffering, and just-in-time hardware deployment.
  • Maintain accurate in-transit inventory records and ensure proper chain-of-custody documentation for all shipments.
  • Manage all shipment-related documentation in relevant systems (Jira, TMS, or equivalent), ensuring records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Manage customs documentation and clearance processes for all cross-border shipments within APAC, including imports into Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.
  • Process and reconcile logistics invoices; manage payments for transportation operations, including ZIP payments to the appropriate vendors and partners.
  • Work with the security team to establish and maintain secure shipment protocols for high-value hardware across the region.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure all shipments comply with applicable regulations across APAC jurisdictions, including country-specific import/export requirements, customs procedures, and trade compliance obligations.
  • Manage duties, taxes, and customs declarations for inbound and outbound shipments across the region, ensuring correct classification and valuation of high-value IT hardware.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation for all logistics activities, supporting internal (SOX) and external compliance requirements.
  • Establish and enforce SLAs and KPIs with freight carriers, forwarders, and 3PL partners; drive accountability through regular performance reviews.
  • Identify and escalate compliance gaps or process deviations, implementing corrective actions as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with hardware engineering, procurement, finance, and data center operations to align APAC logistics execution with deployment timelines and business priorities.
  • Collaborate with OEM suppliers based in Taiwan to coordinate international shipping windows, batch tracking, customs documentation, and inbound scheduling into APAC facilities.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for transport-related issues across the APAC region.
  • Work closely with the global transport team to ensure regional operations align with global standards, processes, and reporting requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through KPI tracking, root cause analysis, and process standardisation.

Planning & Cost Management

  • Forecast transportation demand across APAC based on data center expansion plans, hardware deployment schedules, and capacity needs.
  • Identify cost optimisation opportunities through carrier consolidation, routing improvements, and smarter scheduling across APAC lanes.
  • Track and report on regional logistics costs, flagging variances and recommending corrective actions.
  • Support data-driven decision-making through regular reporting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in transportation, freight, or logistics management, with a strong focus on international shipping within the APAC region.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APAC freight markets, air freight lanes, and road transport operations — particularly routes involving Taiwan, Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.
  • Proven experience managing high-value, time-critical IT hardware shipments — server racks, GPUs, data center equipment, or similar cargo.
  • Strong understanding of customs regulations, import/export procedures, and trade compliance across multiple APAC jurisdictions.
  • Experience managing and negotiating with carriers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners across the APAC region.
  • Hands-on experience with RMA/RMS shipment processes and reverse logistics flows.
  • Familiarity with TMS platforms, Jira, or similar systems used for shipment tracking and documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and documentation skills with a high standard for accuracy and completeness.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to work cross-functionally across technical and non-technical teams in a global environment.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.
  • Based in the APAC region; Singapore, India, or South Korea preferred. Must be eligible to work in the country of residence.
  • Fluency in English required; additional Asian languages (Mandarin, Korean, Hindi, or similar) are a strong advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or large-scale data center build-out environment.
  • Familiarity with ATA Carnet processes and temporary import/export mechanisms for repair and return shipments.
  • Experience with Taiwan-origin shipments and familiarity with Taiwanese export procedures and OEM supplier logistics coordination.
  • Background in supply chain analytics, reporting, or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with physical security protocols for high-value hardware shipments.
  • Experience supporting logistics operations across emerging APAC markets such as Indonesia, Vietnam, or Thailand.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

A Senior PM consistently operates at a higher level of complexity, carries our most demanding client relationships, and can be trusted to deliver in ambiguity without a playbook handed to them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements, owning scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholders on each.

  • Set and hold delivery standards: consistent use of our internal processes, tooling, and artifacts (backlogs, schedules, status, governance) so quality doesn’t depend on who’s assigned.
  • Mentor and level up other PMs and delivery team members; serve as an SME and a model for how the role is done well.

What sets a Senior PM apart (how we level)

Because we don’t level on tenure, these are the differentiators we look for:

  • Scope & complexity — you regularly run engagements of significant size, complexity, and stakeholder difficulty, and you’ve done it across a meaningful number of projects, not just once.
  • Multi-client capability (required) — you handle multiple clients simultaneously, with the context-switching, prioritization, and range that demands. Deeply dedicated single-client portfolio leadership is the Program Manager lane, not Senior PM.
  • Influence — you shape how we deliver, not just what gets delivered; other PMs and consultants are better because of how you work.
  • Consultative judgment — clients trust you with decisions, not just task tracking.
  • Order under ambiguity — you bring structure without needing everything pre-built for you.

Requirements

  • 6 years of project management experience in professional services or consulting delivery, including 6 years running multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, high-risk, or high-visibility projects to successful outcomes.
  • Strong command of both traditional and agile delivery (backlog management, iteration planning, product-owner collaboration).
  • Fluency in our delivery tooling ([Jira, Confluence]) and a track record of following and enforcing standard delivery processes.
  • Comfort in a lean, fast-changing environment — building what isn’t there rather than waiting for structure.

Preferred certifications & accreditations

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or comparable agile credential
  • Atlassian accreditations ([Jira, Confluence, relevant technical accreditations])
  • Relevant AI-delivery or tooling accreditations

Who thrives here

Isos is a lean, fast-evolving practice. The people who do best embrace ambiguity, treat gaps as a chance to put their mark on something rather than a problem handed to them, and can hold structure and flexibility in the same hand. If you need every process defined before you can move, this won’t be the right fit. If you like bringing order to a little healthy chaos, you’ll do well here.

About Isos Technology

Isos Technology is a premier consulting services provider dedicated to empowering organizations through technology, people, and best practices. Founded in 2005, we began by creating Enterprise Java solutions and quickly embraced Jira and Confluence to enhance our consulting practice. Recognizing the power of these tools, we transitioned to become an Atlassian Partner in 2014 and attained Platinum Solution Partner status in 2016. Today, we're focused solely on Atlassian, with a mission to excel as the top Atlassian consulting firm in the US. In 2022, Isos joined The Acacia Group and expanded its reach by acquiring MajorKey Technologies, HyperVelocity Consulting, and Stack Intelligence's Atlassian practices. The Role

Every gift to Crisis Text Line helps someone in crisis get support when they need it most. As our Major Gifts Officer, you’ll build the relationships behind that support.

This is a chance to build a major gifts program while it’s still taking shape. You’ll manage your own portfolio of donors and prospects, work side by side with our board and senior leaders, and have real say in how we find, engage, and thank the people who make our work possible.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of major donors and prospective donors, with individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans

  • Partner with board members and organizational leadership to identify prospects, strengthen relationships, and create opportunities for engagement

  • Lead donor meetings and conversations, and conduct regular outreach including calls, events, and personalized communications

  • Lead and mentor team members, helping them grow their skills and their donor relationships
  • Collaborate across Development, Marketing and Communications, and other teams to support donor events, share our impact and funding priorities, and keep donor work connected to the rest of the organization
  • Help build a sustainable major gifts program by setting up processes and strategy as it grows, and take initiative in an evolving environment

Required Qualifications

These are the skills you’ll need to do this work. We care about what you can do, not how you learned it.

  • Hands-on experience independently managing a portfolio of donors and guiding people from first conversation through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship
  • Comfort making the ask, and following up on both cold and warm leads
  • Build trusting relationships with major donors, board members, senior leaders, and outside partners, listening closely and adapting to what each donor cares about
  • Represent Crisis Text Line with confidence and credibility, leading conversations and meetings with donors, board members, and senior leaders
  • Communicate clearly in writing and in person, and collaborate across teams and functions
  • Stay organized across many donor relationships and shifting priorities, and track your work in a CRM or donor database
  • Protect confidential donor information, work independently, and make decisions when processes are still being built

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience would be useful, but we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every item:

  • Experience asking donors for large gifts and closing them
  • Experience growing and stewarding donor relationships across individuals, foundations, and corporate partners
  • Experience finding new donors through referrals, research, or community ties, and partnering with board members on fundraising
  • Experience mentoring and leading people
  • Experience building a fundraising program or process
  • Experience in nonprofit and/or grantmaking organizations, healthcare, mental health, or volunteer-driven settings

Department Summary

Our Development team sits at the heart of Crisis Text Line, fueling the philanthropic partnerships that make our mission sustainable and scalable. We work with a growing portfolio of foundations and individual donors who share our belief in the power of technology and human connection to reach people in their most vulnerable moments, securing both unrestricted operating support and targeted funding for the programs, innovation, and research that define our impact.

No visa sponsorship available for this position.

Crisis Text Line recognizes that we are all unique human beings with unique life circumstances, and our benefits package aims to be as flexible as possible to support your needs as you work to promote mental well-being for people, wherever they are. As a Distinguished Engineer within Servicing Tech, you'll set the multi-year technical direction for the systems and platforms that serve 1 in 6 U.S. mortgage clients. Servicing Tech is the backbone of loan management at Rocket. Our teams across Servicing Digital, Servicing Core, Servicing Platform, Non-Performing Loans, and Team Member Experience build and operate everything from the client portal on to the internal systems that loan servicing, collections, finance, compliance, and investor relations rely on across the loan lifecycle.

We are entering a pivotal chapter. A full-scale System of Record modernization will reshape the technical foundation beneath our client experiences and our internal operations. AI-driven workflows and decisioning will redefine how servicing works at scale. The engineers who join us now will not inherit a finished system. They will build the one that replaces it.

The Distinguished Engineer role sits above any single team within that transformation. You'll formulate the strategy for the next-generation servicing system, the AI-based workflows that run on top of it, and the platform integrations that connect Servicing Tech to the rest of Rocket and out to investors, regulators, and partners. You'll define the AI-enabled future of the systems beneath our client and internal experiences, and own the architectural patterns that hold Servicing Tech together as it modernizes.

Distinguished Engineers are among the most senior individual contributors in the company. They set multi-year technical direction across multiple domains and shape how the business builds and operates technology. They formulate foundational platform strategy, translate emerging research into production capability, define the AI-enabled future of our engineering platforms, develop the next generation of senior ICs, and represent the company in the broader industry. They are on the path to Tech Fellow.

In this role, that mandate translates into three connected bets: the next-generation servicing system that will replace our legacy System of Record, the AI-based workflows that will run on top of it, and the platform integrations that connect it to the rest of Rocket. You'll own the technical direction across all three and the platform-level patterns that hold them together.

  • Mentor Principal Engineers with the explicit aim of developing future Distinguished Engineers, and shape the engineering culture of the vertical as a named outcome of the role.

  • Significant tenure as a senior individual contributor (typically a Principal-or-equivalent track) with demonstrable company-wide impact across multiple domains.

  • Sustained external presence in the engineering community per the recognition criteria above.

  • Evidence of having owned at least one multi-year technical bet end-to-end, including accountability for the outcome.

  • Bachelor's or higher in Computer Science or a related field welcome but secondary to demonstrated impact and recognition.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in platform building, including the design and stewardship of foundational platforms that multiple product teams build on for years.

  • Demonstrated company-wide and cross-domain technical impact, with a track record of work that altered the trajectory of multiple parts of the business rather than a single team or stack.

  • Multi-year strategic thinking with a credible record of placing foundational technical bets, including bets that took years to validate and at least some that did not pay off.

  • Experience translating research, emerging tools, or industry shifts into production-grade platforms.

  • Sustained external recognition, demonstrated by two or more of: recurring conference talks at recognized venues, peer-reviewed or widely-cited writing, maintainer-level open-source contribution, standards-body participation, or named external advisory roles.

  • Track record of advising executives in their own language and translating multi-year technical strategy into terms the business can act on.

  • Demonstrated development of senior ICs into the next level, including Principal Engineers, or comparable evidence of growing the technical leadership bench.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

Job Ad (2026 05)

We're looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to run our production deployments and act as the operational point of contact for our US-based client team.

The role has two modes. During release cycles, you focus on planning and executing deployments alongside the client. Between releases, you focus on improving the infrastructure and tooling that supports them: CI/CD pipelines, runbooks, observability, automation.

The right person for this role is comfortable in Kubernetes and Helm, knows their way around a Linux shell, and is fine flexing into US working hours when there's a deployment in flight. You're someone who likes things to work, communicates clearly when they don't, and stays calm when production is on the line.

WHAT YOU'RE GOING TO DO

During deployment cycles:

● Plan, schedule, and execute production deployments in coordination with the client's engineering team

● Flex into US working hours (afternoon/evening Romania time) during deployment windows to align with the client on releases, change requests, and incident response

● Act as the day-to-day operational point of contact between our team and the client during release cycles

● Investigate and resolve deployment, networking, and infrastructure issues in production, escalating to the engineering team when needed

● Communicate deployment status, risks, and incidents clearly to both client and internal teams

Between deployment cycles:

● Improve the deployment infrastructure and tooling: CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, runbooks, observability, automation

● Work on broader cloud and Kubernetes operations: cluster maintenance, networking, secret management, cost and reliability improvements

● Help shape deployment processes and change management as the platform grows

Requirements

QUALITIES

● You take pride in clean, predictable deployments and good change discipline

● You enjoy working directly with a client team: writing tickets, joining their stand-ups when needed, being the single point of contact during deployment windows

● You're fine with a schedule that flexes (some weeks heavy US overlap, some weeks normal EU hours) instead of a fixed 9-to-5

● You stay composed during incidents and communicate clearly under pressure

● You ask questions when something looks wrong instead of pushing through

● You document what you do, so the next person (or you, three months from now) doesn't

have to reverse-engineer it

● Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) as part of your daily workflow

QUALIFICATIONS

● 3+ years of experience in operations, DevOps, SRE, or related hands-on infrastructure roles

● Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

● Solid Kubernetes experience: deployments, services, ingress, debugging pods and workloads.

● Scripting and coding in bash, Python, or Go

● Strong written and spoken English (mandatory: you'll be in daily contact with the client)

NICE TO HAVE

● Prior experience working directly with US-based clients or distributed teams

● On-call or production support experience in an enterprise / regulated environment

● Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry)

● Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools

● Experience with secret management tools (Vault, CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)

● Completed technical university degree

WHAT WE OFFER

● A monthly amount dedicated to well-being needs

● A monthly subscription to medical services

● 21 vacation days / year; extra vacation days after 2 years within the company

● 3 personal days / year

● Referral bonus

● Access to learning platforms for continuous self-development

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

About us

We're creating the foundational backend systems that power private market access, from secure authentication and transaction processing to portfolio management and regulatory compliance.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own the systems where money moves and balances have to be correct — the ledger, transaction processing, and the settlement and reconciliation workflows behind our platform. This is the correctness core of what we build. If a balance is wrong, a transaction double-processes, or a reconciliation silently drifts, nothing else we build matters.

You'll design the double-entry ledger, the money-movement engine, and the long-running state machines that carry complex financial workflows to completion reliably over hours, days, or weeks. You'll reason about idempotency, concurrency, partial failure, and replay as a matter of habit, not as an afterthought.

You'll own core infrastructure decisions and set the standard for how we build financial systems.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Design and build the double-entry ledger and money-movement engine that all transactions reconcile against
  • Model complex financial workflows as robust, observable state machines that run reliably over long periods
  • Guarantee financial correctness under concurrency: idempotent operations, transactional integrity, and reconciliation that ties out to the cent
  • Handle partial-failure and replay cases so no event is lost, duplicated, or applied twice
  • Build secure, well-versioned APIs
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and data models
  • Debug production issues and own the reliability of mission-critical financial workflows

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of backend development on production systems
  • Demonstrated money-movement correctness experience: you've built a ledger, settlement system, payments core, or transaction-processing system and can talk in detail about how you kept it correct

Track vacancy statuses and build automated/manual outreach workflows.

  • Smart Automation & Reporting: Automate repetitive enrichment, role matching, and follow-ups. Document processes and report on key metrics (qualified opportunities, drop-off points, top-performing channels) to guide strategy.
  • Comply with the Organization's Information Security Management System (ISMS), including all applicable information security policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines. 

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 3+ years in Marketing Operations, MarTech, CRM, or Revenue Operations.
  • HubSpot Expertise: Hands-on experience building workflows, custom properties, segmentation, forms, sequences, reports, and integrations.
  • Integrations & Automation: Practical experience connecting CRMs, email, website platforms, and data enrichment tools using APIs, webhooks, Zapier, or Make.

Education & Industry

  • 7+ years of experience in the healthcare industry (e.g., hospital administration, strategic planning, PMO, management consulting)

Description

As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet.

S&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT-1/VT-2 or similar).

The ideal candidate brings experience with LR/SLR application and implementation and an optional combination of nuclear engineering programs, field trade experience (e.g., operations or maintenance), work management/scheduling, NRC submittals and/or inspections, and can bridge between technical aging management requirements, work management systems, and field execution.

Key Responsibilities

License renewal & aging management implementation

  • Support LR/SLR implementation activities such as procedure changes, preventive maintenance (PM) basis and frequency development, work order (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates.
  • Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs.
  • Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements.

Work Management & Coordination Responsibilities

  • Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR opportunities in both online and outage scopes.
  • Screen and analyze large WO and PM lists (often thousands of line items) to identify high-value inspection opportunities based on system, component, material, and environment.
  • Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans.

Engineering basis, documentation & configuration control

  • Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications.
  • Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR-related documents and commitments.
  • Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation.

Stakeholder engagement & SME coordination

  • Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results.
  • Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and documentation expectations.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, technology-forward thinking, and cross-functional collaboration across engineering, planning, and implementation teams.

Regulatory awareness & operating experience

  • Maintain awareness of changes in LR/SLR and aging management regulations, guidance, and industry operating experience.
  • Incorporate relevant NUREGs, NEI guidance, and industry OE into program basis documents, implementation strategies, and inspection plans.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills

  • An associate’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5 or more years of experience in the design and analysis of nuclear, industrial, or DOE facilities.
  • Proven experience managing and/or participating in multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Experience in managing medium-to-large critical projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in providing guidance, mentoring, and training to staff engineers
  • Licensed Operator for a Utility
  • Experience delivering accurate, high-quality technical documentation in a highly regulated environment (nuclear, DOE, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear QA/QC protocols, and configuration management processes.
  • Strong systems thinking skills, with the ability to balance innovation with compliance, safety, and traceability.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with work management systems (e.g., work orders, PMs, planning tools) and to align technical requirements with implementable work packages and schedules.
  • Proven capability to collaborate with SMEs and field organizations, using drawings, histories, prior WOs, and data to converge on practical implementation solutions.

Preferred Experience

License renewal, SLR, and aging management

  • Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs, including development or implementation of AMPs, one-time inspections, or selective leaching programs.
  • Experience with NRC, INPO, or DOE regulations, and participation in NRC audits or inspections (e.g., Inspection Procedure 71003 or similar).
  • Familiarity with key nuclear industry LR/SLR documents such as NUREG‑1800, NUREG‑1801, NEI 95‑10, NUREG‑2191, NUREG‑2192, NUREG‑2221, NEI 17‑01, and/or NUREG‑1555.
  • Participation and/or familiarity with the Nuclear Energy Institute (NEI) License Renewal Task Force or similar industry working groups.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Supply Chain Senior Manager – Global Supply Chain Lead

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the end-to-end supply chain for a product portfolio, with a strong focus on reliable patient supply, long-term value, and cross-functional alignment. Working across functions, you will anticipate risks and opportunities, turn insights into clear plans, and enable timely decisions that protect continuity of supply. You will also help shape supply chain and lifecycle choices that strengthen resilience and improve financial performance. The role sits within a multinational and multicultural environment that offers strong opportunities for collaboration, learning, and professional growth.

Responsibilities:

Strategy:

  • Provide thought leadership in shaping end-to-end product supply strategies, orchestrating long-range and monthly planning cycles, and driving business-critical lifecycle management decisions and implementation of product strategies.

  • Ensure every patient, every time by proactively anticipate risks and opportunities, leading cross-functional Supply Chain Teams to develop mitigation plans to protect continuity of supply.

  • Represent Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain in cross-functional product teams, driving alignment on the end-to-end product supply strategy, key risks, opportunities and lifecycle decisions.

  • Advise on manufacturing site selection, network evaluations and business cases by translating end-to-end supply chain insights and scenarios into clear recommendations that influence supply chain design.

  • Lead and support strategic Global Supply Chain initiatives, including acquisitions, integrations and transformations, to enable continued growth.

Execution:

  • Ensure global demand and supply plans are aligned with the agreed product supply strategy and provide a reliable basis for decision making through the planning cycle.

  • Monitor product supply and inventory performance against agreed targets and guardrails, using metrics and exceptions to identify issues and drive timely corrective actions.

  • Set and maintain appropriate inventory targets and guardrails for assigned products, working with manufacturing sites, network planning and Finance to maintain a healthy supply plan and protect continuity of supply. Consider cost and financial impact in product supply and inventory decisions, while keeping continuity of supply and patient service as key priorities.

  • Maintain an end-to-end understanding of the product supply chain, including lead times, critical raw materials, capacity and other key planning assumptions, and ensure these are reflected in supply decisions.

  • Share and develop best practices across the Global Supply Chain network through initiatives that improve supply chain processes, systems and ways of working.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • Master’s degree and 4 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Supply Chain, Operations directly or related experience OR

  • Associate degree and 10 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience OR

  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Supply Chain, Operations or directly related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication capabilities and must be comfortable and confident dealing with all levels of management within the organization.

  • Strong digital mindset, with demonstrated ability to leverage digital tools, data, and automation to improve supply chain planning insights and decision making.

  • Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes across a matrix organization.

  • 7 plus years of experience in global pharmaceutical, biotech or any other industry.

  • Solid understanding of demand/supply planning, Supply Chain principles and logistics.

  • Ability to perform system-based advanced supply planning and scenario analysis.

  • Diligent with strong business analytical skills and company-wide knowledge.

  • Process-oriented mentality with leadership experience to identify gaps and seek solutions.

  • Perseverance and independent problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge and understanding of COGM, COGS and NPV analyses.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Job Title: Principal, Regulatory Science and Strategy - Real World Solutions

Job Location: London, Greater London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote
