jobs.description:
Fractional CFO / Finance-Focused Virtual Assistant

Role Overview

This role is built for someone who is more than a basic administrative assistant. We need a fractional CFO-level or finance-focused virtual assistant who brings real finance experience, not just light bookkeeping, and who can take ownership of financial visibility and reporting end to end. The business owner was away from day-to-day operations for six months, and the books, CRM, and AR tracking need to be cleaned up, reconciled, and put on a reliable ongoing cadence.

This is a high-trust, high-responsibility position. We are looking for someone who can move from cleanup mode into steady-state financial operations, and who has the potential to expand into marketing, admin, or operations support once the finances are stabilized.

Key Responsibilities

Core Financial / CFO Support

Clean up messy books resulting from a six-month gap in oversight

Extract and reconcile accurate accounts receivable (AR) data directly from the CRM (Proline) rather than relying solely on QuickBooks

Deliver ongoing weekly financial reporting to maintain consistent financial visibility

Support forecasting preparation and ongoing forecast maintenance

Manage AR tracking and AP support, including invoices, recurring expenses, and job costing

Own QuickBooks as the primary bookkeeping platform

Systems / Data Integrity

Clean up and manage CRM (Proline) data so it stays aligned with financial records

Either bring existing Proline experience, or be capable of learning Proline quickly through structured mentoring

After-Hours Coverage / Lead Capture

Answer phone calls after the office closes, during the evening call window

Respond to general/common questions from callers

Capture leads and log every call in Proline with clear, detailed notes

Create follow-up tasks and define next steps for each call to ensure no lead is dropped

Candidate Profile

Real finance or accounting experience, beyond basic data entry or light bookkeeping

Demonstrated ability to own financial reporting and visibility end to end, not just execute isolated tasks

Comfortable working independently to untangle and correct disorganized financial records

Strong attention to detail and consistency, especially when reconciling CRM and accounting data

Clear, professional phone and written communication for after-hours caller interactions

Proline CRM experience preferred; willingness and aptitude to learn it is required if not already known

Growth-oriented: open to taking on marketing, admin, or operations responsibilities as the role evolves

Why This Role Matters

This business is currently experiencing real financial pain: disorganized books, inaccurate AR, and missed after-hours calls that translate directly into lost revenue. This hire is intended to stop that bleeding and build a dependable financial and lead-capture foundation going forward.

Engagement Notes

The business owner is being deliberate and wants clarity on the candidate's experience level and the value delivered before committing long-term

Expect an initial cleanup phase, followed by transition into steady, ongoing weekly reporting and after-hours coverage

Role scope may expand over time into marketing, admin, or operations once financial systems are stable

jobs.title: Trauma-Informed Mindfulness & Wellness Skills Coach
jobs.excerpt: About the PracticeIntuitive Psychiatry is a San Francisco-based outpatient psychiatric practice providing thoughtful, evidence-informed care to adults with anxiety, depression, ADHD, insomnia, trauma-related concerns, and related mental-health needs.
jobs.description:
About the Practice

Intuitive Psychiatry is a San Francisco-based outpatient psychiatric practice providing thoughtful, evidence-informed care to adults with anxiety, depression, ADHD, insomnia, trauma-related concerns, and related mental-health needs. We are building a supportive wellness-skills program to help clinically stable patients practice effective self-regulation strategies between psychiatric appointments. This program complements, and does not replace, psychiatric care and psychotherapy.

We are seeking a warm, highly reliable, trauma-informed Mindfulness & Wellness Skills Coach with strong training in pranayama/breathwork, yoga-informed mindfulness, and health coaching. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills, cultural humility, professional boundaries, and the ability to connect authentically with U.S.-based adult patients.

Requirements

Role Summary

The Trauma-Informed Mindfulness & Wellness Skills Coach will provide structured, non-psychotherapy wellness support to clinician-referred adult outpatients in California, working under the direction of each patient's psychiatric provider. This is a non-clinical, non-therapy role with a clearly defined scope.

  • Conduct brief individual wellness coaching sessions.
  • Create individualized, clinician-aligned wellness routines.
  • Teach safe, practical breathwork, mindfulness, grounding, and sleep-support skills.
  • Facilitate live virtual group classes focused on stress regulation, emotional wellness, sleep optimization, and skills practice.
  • Support patients in developing consistent practices between psychiatric appointments.
  • Communicate clinically relevant concerns to the patient's treating psychiatrist or psychiatric nurse practitioner through approved secure channels.

Engagement & Schedule

  • Independent contractor; remote position, candidate may be based in India.
  • Anticipated initial capacity of approximately 10–20 hours per week, ramping with patient volume.
  • Required availability overlapping with U.S. Pacific Time, including a combination of daytime and evening hours.
  • Flexible schedule based on patient demand and practice needs.
  • Approximately 2–4 live virtual groups per week, subject to patient volume and program growth.
  • Individual patient sessions are generally 30 minutes per month per enrolled patient.
  • Adults only; all patients are located in California.

Compensation

  • Hourly rate for completed, documented individual wellness-coaching sessions (generally scheduled in 30-minute increments).
  • A separate agreed flat rate for each live virtual group session facilitated (applies only to groups scheduled, conducted live, and documented per practice policy).
  • The contractor is not responsible for claims, coverage determinations, billing codes, or billing patients/insurers — all payer billing is managed solely by the practice.
  • The practice determines, at its discretion, whether coaching activity supports care-management billing or is provided as an included patient benefit.
  • Compensation for cancellations, no-shows, admin time, training, supervision, and documentation, if any, is governed by the independent contractor agreement or separate written policy.
  • Independent contractor engagement: the contractor is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, workspace, equipment, internet, and other business expenses, except as expressly agreed in writing.

Key Responsibilities

Individual Wellness Skills Coaching

  • Conduct initial individual wellness consultations for clinician-referred patients.
  • Complete a structured, non-diagnostic wellness intake covering patient goals, prior practice experience, sleep/stress/emotional-regulation concerns, barriers to consistent practice, and any past adverse reactions to breath- or body-focused work.
  • Develop individualized wellness routines using practice-approved techniques, consistent with the patient's psychiatric care plan.
  • Teach practical skills patients can safely use between appointments, and support adherence and routine-building.
  • Track patient-reported sleep, stress, mood, and practice adherence, as relevant to the care plan.
  • Modify wellness routines within the approved scope based on patient feedback, tolerance, and stated goals.
  • Help patients identify when concerns should be brought to their treating psychiatric provider.

Group Facilitation

  • Facilitate live, virtual, video-based wellness-skills groups for adults who have completed an initial individual consultation.
  • Provide welcoming, structured, trauma-informed, culturally responsive group experiences focused on stress management, breath-based relaxation, mindfulness, sleep-supportive routines, yoga nidra and body scans, gentle movement, ADHD-friendly regulation strategies, and practical daily-life application.
  • Maintain group safety, privacy, professional boundaries, and respectful participation.
  • Follow practice policy prohibiting recordings, screenshots, photography, and sharing of participant information.
  • Ensure participants understand they may stop or modify any practice at any time.

Care-Plan Support and Documentation

  • Deliver health education and individualized wellness-skills coaching that supports the patient's established care plan.
  • Document coaching activities, time spent, patient response, home-practice plan, and relevant concerns in the practice's designated chronic care management platform.
  • Maintain accurate group attendance records and use approved templates and workflows.
  • Promptly communicate clinically relevant concerns, requests for clinical guidance, or signs of deterioration to the treating provider through secure practice channels.
  • Participate in required supervision, training, and quality-assurance processes.

Approved Wellness Interventions

The coach may provide practice-approved, low-risk, non-medical wellness education and skills training, including:

  • Slow diaphragmatic breathing; paced or resonant breathing; box breathing; gentle, free-flowing pranayama techniques.
  • Grounding and orienting exercises; mindfulness practices; guided body scans.
  • Yoga nidra and sleep-supportive relaxation exercises.
  • Gentle movement, chair-based movement, and stretching.
  • Routine-building and practice-adherence strategies.

The coach must follow the practice's approved training and protocol for every intervention.

Scope Limitations & Safety Boundaries

The coach is not a therapist, medical provider, or crisis clinician. The coach must not:

  • Diagnose or assess psychiatric conditions.
  • Provide psychotherapy, counseling, trauma processing, exposure therapy, or crisis counseling.
  • Independently assess suicide risk, self-harm risk, homicidal risk, psychosis, mania/hypomania, or level of care.
  • Provide medication education, recommendations, interpretation, or advice to start, stop, or change medications.
  • Provide medical, nutritional, or dietetic advice, or recommend supplements, herbs, Ayurvedic medicines, detoxes, or fasting.
  • Present Ayurveda, yoga, mindfulness, or breathwork as treatment or cure for psychiatric illness.
  • Offer legal, financial, relationship, or other professional advice outside the assigned role.
  • Use high-intensity, hyperventilation-based, forceful, cathartic, or prolonged-breath-retention techniques.
  • Lead practices intended to induce altered states, catharsis, traumatic-memory recall, or emotional “release.”
  • Continue a practice when a patient reports distress, panic, dizziness, dissociation, or other concerning symptoms.
  • Manage emergency situations independently.

The coach must promptly notify the treating provider or designated practice escalation contact of clinical or safety concerns and follow all practice escalation procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong spoken and written English, including the ability to communicate clearly, warmly, and professionally with U.S.-based adult patients.
  • Formal training and demonstrated experience in mindfulness, breathwork/pranayama, yoga-informed wellness, health coaching, or a closely related discipline.
  • Training in trauma-informed care and demonstrated ability to facilitate practices emphasizing choice, consent, pacing, patient autonomy, and emotional safety.
  • Formal health-coaching education or a recognized coaching certification; international coaching training strongly preferred.
  • Yoga teacher training or comparable formal yoga/pranayama education strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting individuals with anxiety, depression, ADHD, insomnia, stress dysregulation, and/or trauma-related symptoms.
  • Familiarity with the boundaries between wellness coaching, psychotherapy, and medical care.
  • Excellent active listening, rapport-building, and group-facilitation skills.
  • Cultural humility and demonstrated awareness that U.S.-based patients may have different cultural contexts, stressors, expectations, and healthcare experiences.
  • Exceptional reliability, punctuality, organization, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable working with secure patient portals, video platforms, structured documentation, and digital workflows.
  • Willingness and ability to complete all required practice onboarding and training before seeing patients.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a behavioral-health, psychiatric, medical, or integrated-care setting.
  • Experience facilitating online groups.
  • Training in sleep-supportive mindfulness, yoga nidra, ADHD coaching strategies, or stress-management education.
  • Formal Ayurveda education or training, provided the candidate understands and agrees to the practice's non-medical, no-supplement/no-treatment scope.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or prior work supporting U.S.-based healthcare organizations.
  • Experience providing culturally responsive support across diverse patient populations.

Technology, Privacy & Security Requirements

The contractor must provide and maintain:

  • A dedicated, encrypted, password-protected computer or device for work.
  • Multi-factor authentication for all practice systems.
  • A private, quiet, professional workspace where patient conversations cannot be overheard.
  • Reliable high-speed internet suitable for live video sessions.
  • Headphones or another privacy-protective audio setup.
  • Ability to use only practice-approved, HIPAA-compliant systems for video, messaging, documentation, and patient communication.

The contractor may not:

  • Use personal email, WhatsApp, SMS/text messaging, social-media messaging, or unapproved applications for patient communication.
  • Share access credentials or use shared logins.
  • Download, print, photograph, record, screenshot, or store protected health information outside approved practice systems.
  • Record individual or group sessions.
  • Permit family members, roommates, or any other person to access or overhear protected health information.

The successful candidate must sign required confidentiality, privacy, data-security, and business-associate-related agreements, as applicable.

Supervision, Training & Probationary Period

The coach will work under the clinical direction of each patient's treating psychiatrist or psychiatric nurse practitioner. Before independently providing patient-facing services, the coach must successfully complete practice onboarding and training, including:

  • HIPAA and confidentiality.
  • Secure communication and data-security practices.
  • Use of the practice's telehealth, patient portal, and CCM documentation systems.
  • Scope-of-practice boundaries and documentation requirements.
  • Patient escalation and emergency procedures.
  • Trauma-informed facilitation and U.S. cultural competence.
  • Approved breathwork, mindfulness, body-scan, yoga nidra, and gentle-movement protocols.
  • Practices and techniques that are prohibited or require specific clinician approval.

The role includes an initial three-month probationary period. Continued engagement will depend on clinical judgment, professionalism, reliability, documentation quality, patient feedback, adherence to scope and privacy requirements, and program needs.

Make Richpanel the company every CX leader knows before they need us.

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk. We replace the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.

We are profitable, backed by Sequoia Capital, and trusted by 3,000+ paying brands. ARR is already in eight figures and growing 110% year over year. Our team is small by design.

DTC gave us our first market. Your job is to make it one of several.

You will own how Richpanel is understood, discovered, discussed, and chosen.

This role combines brand marketing, product marketing, channel building, and new-market development. It reports directly to the CEO.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Build a brand people remember

  • Make Richpanel's point of view clear across our site, decks, events, and customer stories.
  • Build an excellent X presence inside DTC, ecommerce, CX, and AI communities.
  • Turn customer evidence into posts, case studies, research, and conversations worth sharing.

Find the story that wins

  • Join sales calls and interview customers, lost deals, partners, and operators.
  • Test positioning and offers against real buyers.
  • Build battlecards that help sales win against Gorgias, Zendesk, Fin, Decagon, and Sierra.
  • Keep our website and pitch aligned with what buyers believe.

Diversify our channels

  • Make PPC, AEO, content, events, referrals, and partnerships produce qualified pipeline.
  • Set a clear thesis, budget, and success bar for every channel.

• Scale winners. Stop weak bets quickly.

Open enterprise and new verticals

  • Find markets where our product solves urgent, valuable support problems.
  • Build each vertical from research to its first repeatable motion.
  • Define the ICP, triggers, objections, message, proof, channel, and sales play.
  • Help Richpanel win beyond DTC without weakening what already works.

This is a builder's role. You will write, research, ship, and talk to customers yourself.

Requirements

YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF

  • You have 7+ years in B2B SaaS growth, product marketing, brand, or category creation.
  • You have opened a new market, geography, segment, or vertical from zero.
  • You can show work that changed perception and created qualified pipeline.
  • You understand both brand and demand. You do not treat them as separate teams.
  • You write clearly and know how to earn engagement on X.
  • You are comfortable with PPC, AEO, content, events, and partnerships.
  • You have built positioning, launch plans, sales narratives, or competitive battlecards.
  • You enjoy deep research, customer interviews, and field work.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

  • You only manage agencies or large teams.
  • Your answer to every growth problem is more paid spend.

First 90 days

  • Build a repeatable X publishing and engagement system.
  • Launch three channel experiments with clear stop or scale rules.

Six months

  • One non-DTC vertical produces a credible opportunity set and clear win-loss evidence.
  • Richpanel's story is consistent across the website, sales deck, demos, and market conversations.

Benefits

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You are not inheriting a finished playbook. You will decide what Richpanel becomes known for.

You get:

  • Direct access to the CEO, customers, product team, and sales calls.
  • A real budget for research, content, events, and channel experiments.
  • A profitable company with eight-figure ARR, 110% year-over-year growth, and proven customer outcomes.
  • Ownership of the brand, the growth portfolio, and our next markets.
  • A small team with little process between an idea and a live test.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• $190,000 to $225,000 base salary.

  • 20% target performance bonus. Total target cash compensation is $228,000 to $270,000.
  • 0.5% to 1% equity, vested over four years. This is meaningful ownership, not a token grant.

• 25 paid days off each year.

• Learning and development allowance.

  • Annual offsite and quarterly team gatherings.
  • Remote role based in the United States.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. CEO conversation focused on work you personally led.

2. Live working session on one Richpanel vertical and one channel.

3. Evidence review covering writing, research, launches, and business results.

4. Final conversation and references.

We aim to complete the process within two weeks.

Our Vision

uMed seeks to be a cornerstone of the efforts to reduce the burden of disease for patients by radically reducing the barriers to knowledge creation.

Join us.

Our Culture

We are a group of trusting and inclusive individuals, who encourage, are creative and want to make a difference in the world. We do not take ourselves too seriously and we love to tell a story. We innovate, work hard and take risks but at the forefront is a joint mission to be part of groundbreaking research to ultimately advance and develop science to support those most in need.

What we do

The process of conducting clinical research is incredibly expensive and time consuming, limiting our efforts to find answers to the world’s most important medical challenges. uMed is a clinical research network fit for the 21st century, underpinned by cutting edge technology that connects patients, electronic health data and research groups across the world. Our rapidly growing network covers 90 GP sites in the UK representing over 2,000,000 patients with our first US healthcare system joining us this year bringing a further 5M patients. uMed was founded by an NHS doctor, supported by a world class board and backed by London and US based venture capital.

Life at uMed

No matter what an organisation is trying to achieve, success or failure is inextricably linked to the people within it. For a young company, there is no redundancy, so this relationship is turned up to eleven.

At uMed we punch well above our weight due to the quality of the team we have built, and their dedication to our shared vision. Recognising this dedication, we have a fantastic benefits package and accompanying culture at uMed. This includes:

  • A generous private health insurance plan
  • 25 days of paid time off for your well-deserved breaks
  • Work From Home equipment budget for a comfortable working space
  • Flexible Benefits platform tailored to your needs
  • Enjoy your Birthday Day Off on us!
  • Coworking policy - work from any coworking space as regularly as once a week
  • Enhanced Parental Leave



The Role

You will own the growth and strategy of uMed's entire US provider and partner network. This isn't a single-pipeline sales role, it's building the strategy, the team, and the commercial model that gets uMet to offer research opportunities to patients, at the pace uMed's growth plan requires. You'll set which segments to go after and why, build and lead the team that executes it, and be the senior, credible voice in the room with health system executives, EMR partners and payers alongside the company's physician CEO

You'll need to develop a multi-year network growth strategy with the CEO, and personally lead the highest-value, most complex partnership conversations yourself. Over time, this role builds and leads the full US partnerships function.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own the US patient access growth strategy: which segments (independent primary care, IPAs, health systems, specialty networks, EMR partners, payers, and pharmacy networks) to prioritize in service of the company's growth plan
  • Personally own and close the most strategic, highest-value provider and health system relationships
  • Design the commercial model for provider partnerships, including terms, incentives, and contracting approach, working with legal and finance
  • Build, hire, and lead a provider partnerships team as the US network scales, setting targets, process, and playbooks for the function
  • Represent uMed's provider growth strategy and performance to the executive team and board
  • Partner with Operations to ensure the provider experience matches what's promised to our life science customers, and feed provider insight back into product strategy
  • Represent uMed at senior industry forums, conferences, and associations to build brand credibility and pipeline in the US market
  • Own network growth reporting and forecasting: practices signed, patients represented, time-to-live, and network health, as a core input to company planning
  • Be the strategic advisor to the CEO

Relevant de la cheffe d’équipe des directrices, la directrice associée ou directrice de comptes est responsable de la gestion des comptes clients; du développement d’affaires, du rôle-conseil et stratégique auprès des clients. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Ventes et Développement des affaires

  • Assumer la gestion de comptes clients
  • Acquérir une bonne compréhension des objectifs du client et développer une stratégie éducative
  • Connaître la réglementation canadienne relative à l’accréditation des programmes destinés aux professionnels de la santé ainsi que les normes d’éthique
  • Collaborer avec les organisations de médecins, les universités et les associations médicales, et veiller au respect des normes/directives éducatives en matière de soins de santé éthiques
  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de vente et de fidélisation avec des clients existants et nouveaux
  • Positionner les moins bonnes nouvelles et toujours être en mode solution
  • Déléguer les responsabilités de manière stratégique aux gestionnaires de projets et équipes internes
  • Assumer un rôle de leader et de mentor auprès des gestionnaires de projets et comptes
  • Incarner les valeurs de Unik auprès des clients et des collègues: Collaboration, Excellence, Engagement
  • Élaborer des estimés/soumissions (pitch) avec une participation minimale ou nulle des propriétaires d’Unik, et fournir des conseils stratégiques aux propriétaires d’Unik afin de maximiser la rentabilité sans compromettre la qualité
  • Être un leader positif auprès de l’équipe

Organisation et Execution

  • Superviser le projet pour s’assurer que les objectifs du client soient rencontrés
  • Assurer le brief scientifique avec les différents intervenants (rédacteurs médicaux, comité scientifique, etc..) selon la stratégie du client
  • Assister aux appels clients selon l'agenda
  • Réviser les communications au besoin
  • Réviser le contenu scientifique avant l'envoi à la faculté ou au client
  • Réviser les chairs briefs et les soumissions d’accréditation

Contrôle

  • Rentrer ses heures dans Forecast afin d’optimiser la gestion et réconciliation de projets
  • Revoir les propositions de changements de budget et approbation finale des réconciliations avant la facturation
  • S’assurer du contrôle de la qualité de tous les livrables

EXIGENCES

  • Diplôme d’études universitaire de premier ou deuxième cycle, de préférence en sciences, éducation ou en communications
  • Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions similaires dont 3 ans en tant que gestionnaire de comptes

  • Connaissance du milieu pharmaceutique et de l’environnement de l’éducation médicale au Canada
  • Maitrise des outils informatiques – Suite Office
  • Sens de l’organisation et excellentes habilités en communication
  • Approche stratégique, leadership et gestion situations difficiles
  • Habilités à mobiliser les ressources
  • Curiosité et débrouillardise

CONDITIONS DE TRAVAIL ET AVANTAGES

ENGLISH FOLLOWS

La job

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) gestionnaire de comptes axé(e) sur les résultats pour se joindre à notre équipe des ventes dans le secteur des batteries lithium-ion destinées aux équipements de manutention (MHE).

La personne idéale sera responsable d’identifier et de développer de nouvelles occasions d’affaires, de gérer des comptes clés et d’établir de solides relations avec des clients issus de différents secteurs, notamment l’automobile, l’alimentation et les boissons, ainsi que d’autres applications clés.

Le ou la gestionnaire de comptes contribuera activement à la croissance des revenus et au développement de notre présence sur le marché.

Tes responsabilités

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de vente visant à acquérir de nouveaux clients et à développer les affaires auprès des clients existants.
  • Gérer un portefeuille de comptes en développant des relations solides et en maintenant un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
  • Identifier de nouvelles occasions d’affaires par la veille des tendances de l’industrie, la participation à des salons professionnels et le développement de relations avec les principaux acteurs du marché.
  • Présenter et promouvoir nos solutions d’énergie en tant que service auprès de clients actuels et potentiels, en mettant de l’avant leurs avantages et leur valeur ajoutée.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes, notamment l’ingénierie, la production et le soutien à la clientèle, afin d’assurer une livraison fluide des produits et services.
  • Négocier les contrats, les prix et les modalités avec les clients afin de conclure des ententes alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise.
  • Suivre les tendances du marché, les activités de la concurrence et les besoins des clients afin d’alimenter les équipes des ventes et de développement de produits.

Ton profil

  • Expérience en vente ou en gestion de comptes dans le secteur des batteries lithium-ion ou du stockage d’énergie une exigence pour ce poste.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l’atteinte d’objectifs de vente et le développement des affaires.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication, en négociation et en relations interpersonnelles.
  • Capacité à comprendre les spécifications techniques des produits et à les communiquer clairement aux clients.
  • Autonomie, souci du détail et capacité à travailler aussi bien de façon indépendante qu’en équipe.
  • Disponibilité pour se déplacer au Canada/États-Unis afin de rencontrer des clients et de participer à des événements de l’industrie, au besoin.
  • Expérience auprès de clients œuvrant dans les secteurs des véhicules électriques (VE), des énergies renouvelables ou des batteries industrielles.
  • Connaissance des technologies de batteries lithium-ion et de leurs procédés de fabrication.
  • Maîtrise des logiciels CRM et des outils d’analyse des ventes.

Ce que nous avons à offrir

Un rôle stimulant, une équipe exceptionnelle et des bureaux à deux pas du centre-ville de Québec. Une ambiance de scale-up avec de grandes ambitions, où tout le monde travaille dans la même direction pour contribuer au succès de l’entreprise. Des avantages qui facilitent le quotidien, beaucoup de stationnement et un accès facile au transport en commun.

Mais le plus grand avantage chez UgoWork, c’est de joindre une équipe passionnée et compétente et de contribuer à une foule de projets stimulants! En plus :

  • Un salaire attrayant comprenant une composante variable liée à la performance.
  • Une solide machine de génération de prospects pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs.
  • Une occasion unique de vous démarquer dans une industrie tournée vers l’avenir.

Un peu à propos de nous

Établie à Québec depuis 2015, UgoWork est un leader mondial des batteries au lithium et de la gestion d’énergie pour l’industrie des chariots élévateurs (équipements de manutention ou MHE). Nous produisons les meilleures batteries de l’industrie ainsi qu’une offre d’énergie en tant que service qui contribue non seulement à une planète plus verte, mais génère également des gains opérationnels significatifs dans ce secteur essentiel à toutes les industries. Plus de 10 millions de chariots élévateurs circulent chaque jour dans le monde, dans les entrepôts et les usines, assurant une manutention sécuritaire et efficace des marchandises.

---

The job

We are currently seeking a results-driven Account Manager to join our dynamic sales team in the lithium-ion battery for MHE industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing key accounts, and building strong relationships with clients in various sectors, including automotive, food and beverage, and other key applications. The Account Manager will play a crucial role in driving revenue growth and expanding our market presence.

Your responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire new customers and expand business with existing clients.
  • Manage a portfolio of accounts, ensuring strong relationships and high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Identify new business opportunities by researching industry trends, attending trade shows, and networking with key stakeholders.
  • Present and promote our energy as a service solutions to potential and existing clients, highlighting product benefits and value propositions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including engineering, production, and customer support, to ensure seamless delivery of products and services.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with clients to close deals that align with company objectives.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to provide strategic insights to the sales and product development teams.

Your profile

  • Experience in sales or account management in lithium-ion battery or energy storage industries is a requirement.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to understand technical product specifications and effectively convey them to customers.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet clients and attend industry events.
  • Experience working with clients in the electric vehicle (EV), renewable energy, or industrial battery sectors.
  • Familiarity with lithium-ion battery technologies and manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in CRM software and sales analytics tools.

What we have to offer

A stimulating role, an amazing team, and an office just a stone's throw from downtown Quebec City. A scale-up atmosphere with big ambitions, where everyone rows in the same direction for the company’s success. Perks to make your life easier, ample parking, and easy access to public transport. But the biggest perk at UgoWork is joining

a passionate, competent team and accomplishing a ton of exciting projects! Plus:

  • An attractive salary with a performance-based variable component.
  • A great lead generation machine that enables you to meet your objectives
  • A unique chance to stand out in a future-oriented industry.

A little about us

Established in Quebec City since 2015, UgoWork is a global leader in lithium batteries and energy management for the forklift industry (Material Handling Equipment or MHE). We produce the industry's best batteries and an energy as a service offering that not only contribute to a greener planet but also generate substantial operational gains in this vital sector for all industries. Over 10 million forklifts buzz around the planet every day, in warehouses and factories, ensuring goods are handled safely and on time.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Couchbase & Confluent)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionWe're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the company AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes platform, with deep expertise in our data layer: Couchbase and Confluent (Kafka).
jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the company AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes platform, with deep expertise in our data layer: Couchbase and Confluent (Kafka). You'll run these systems in production, keep them fast and reliable as data volumes grow, and work closely with our Python backend, data and AI teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure (EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM).
  • Own Couchbase in production: cluster architecture and sizing, buckets and indexes (GSI), XDCR replication, backup/restore, upgrades, and performance tuning.
  • Own the Confluent / Kafka platform: Confluent Platform or Confluent Cloud, topic and partition design, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect connectors, consumer lag, throughput tuning and upgrades.
  • Run stateful workloads on production Kubernetes, including Couchbase and Kafka operators, Helm, cluster scaling and upgrades.
  • Manage all infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and data services.
  • Own monitoring, logging and alerting across the platform, including Couchbase and Kafka health; lead incident response and post-mortems.
  • Support data and AI/LLM workloads and keep cloud costs in check.

Requirements

Requirements (must-have):

  • 5+ years in DevOps / SRE / platform engineering, with 3+ years running AWS and Kubernetes in production.
  • Expert-level Couchbase: hands-on production administration of Couchbase Server clusters (architecture, XDCR, indexing, backup/restore, upgrades, performance tuning).
  • Expert-level Confluent / Apache Kafka: hands-on production operation of Confluent Platform or Confluent Cloud (brokers, Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, partitioning, consumer lag, scaling).
  • Kubernetes in production, including running stateful workloads with operators.
  • AWS: EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC.
  • Terraform / infrastructure as code.
  • CI/CD pipeline design and ownership.
  • Observability and incident response (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / CloudWatch).
  • Docker / containerization.
  • Scripting in Python and Bash.
  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals.
  • Fluent in English and Ukrainian.

Nice to Have:

  • Certifications: Confluent Certified Administrator for Apache Kafka, Couchbase certification, CKA.
  • Couchbase Capella or Confluent Cloud managed-service experience.
  • Couchbase Autonomous Operator or Confluent for Kubernetes / Strimzi.
  • ksqlDB / Kafka Streams; CDC pipelines (e.g. Debezium).
  • ArgoCD / GitOps.
  • Infrastructure for ML/LLM workloads.
  • FinOps / cloud cost optimization.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in Canada and US.

The Opportunity:

The Grafana Search & Storage squad is developing Grafana’s next-generation storage layer. As a key component of our App Platform, Unified Storage enables developers to build innovative applications using a Kubernetes-inspired Operator pattern to interact with data directly.

In addition to operating Unified Storage at scale within Grafana Cloud, our team manages two essential features for discovery and organization: Search, the unified engine for finding and querying all Grafana data, and Folders, for hierarchical content management.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives
  • Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.
  • Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers
  • Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope
  • Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and
  • availability
  • Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running
  • Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team
  • Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system
  • As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action
  • You are customer focused
  • We build everything with our users in mind.
  • You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs
  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively
  • Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must
  • Solid experience with Go, Rust, Python, or other similar programming languages
  • Demonstrated knowledge of and experience working with large distributed systems
  • Experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way
  • Experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud o r experience with systems engineering

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Bonus Points For:

  • Have been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)
  • Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code

In Canada, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is CAD $164,490 - $197,389. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Job Description

Role title: Data Migration Engineer

Salary range: $60,000 - $90,000 USD

Location: Remote - US - Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta

Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Engineer to join our Data Services team. This role is responsible for migrating customer data from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products while ensuring business continuity, data quality, and customer satisfaction.

As a strategic contributor within Data Services, the Data Migration Engineer works closely with new and existing customers to deliver high quality, customized data migration solutions that support unique business needs. The role collaborates cross functionally with teams across Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to deliver complex, end-to-end migration outcomes.

While this role involves taking ownership of assigned tasks and tickets, it operates as part of a global Data Services team leveraging a Follow the Sun delivery model to keep data moving across regions and time zones. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to contribute effectively to a broader team-based delivery motion as tools, platforms, and processes continue to evolve.

What you’ll own

  • Own and execute assigned components of end-to-end data conversion and migration efforts from legacy systems to Applied Systems SaaS products, producing sample and final deliveries using SQL-based tooling
  • Perform data extractions, acquisition mergers, transformations, and data cleanup/quality services to support a wide range of customer scenarios and business requirements
  • Develop standardized, efficient, and repeatable data scripts and workflows; perform audits and validation to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency throughout the migration lifecycle
  • Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, and deliver migration outcomes that maintain business continuity
  • Contribute to a global delivery model by completing work independently while ensuring smooth handoffs and continuity across teams operating in different regions and time zones
  • Remain adaptable to changing project plans and timelines, adjusting execution approaches as rescheduling or contingency planning is required
  • Collaborate closely with Development teams to support testing, defect resolution, enhancements, and implementation of new or evolving solutions, while maintaining clear and accurate Data Services documentation
  • Conduct ongoing analysis of customer data and competitor system structures, identifying opportunities to improve transformation efficiency and solution quality
  • As Data Services tooling evolves, increasingly leverage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery to support migration workflows and downstream integrations
  • Utilize emerging automation and intelligent tooling to improve migration speed, scalability, and quality, and provide feedback that helps shape how these tools are adopted responsibly
  • Contribute to custom solution delivery and continuous improvement initiatives that advance Data Services capabilities, tooling, and processes

What you’ll bring

  • Strong foundational knowledge of database structures and SQL, with demonstrated experience applying these skills in real world data migration, integration, or transformation scenarios
  • Solid understanding of ETL concepts, data mapping, and data quality best practices
  • Comfort working in a collaborative, global team environment where work is shared across regions to maintain continuous delivery
  • Ability to manage multiple competing project timelines while remaining highly detail oriented and customer focused
  • Strong sense of ownership and initiative, balanced with the ability to align work to shared team standards, processes, and delivery goals
  • Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to collaborate comfortably with engineering teams and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline

What could set you apart

  • Hands-on experience supporting SaaS data migration or ETL initiatives in a production environment
  • Experience or exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery and Cloud Storage
  • Experience working with automation frameworks, scripting, or intelligent tools to support data analysis, migration, or quality assurance
  • Interest in helping evaluate, validate, or refine AI assisted or agent-based workflows as part of future data migration capabilities
  • Experience using Jira, SharePoint, or similar tools to track work, collaborate across teams, and document technical processes.

Your background may bring strengths we have not listed here. If the role and its impact interest you, we encourage you to apply

Build a career that moves an industry

Applied is the connective intelligence transforming how insurance works. We build the platforms, data, and intelligent systems that connect agencies and carriers across the insurance lifecycle.

Here, careers move with the work. You can own meaningful decisions, build what reaches the market, expand your scope as the business evolves, and work alongside people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they create.

What you can expect

  • Work with reach: Build products, services, or programs that support agencies, carriers, and teammates across the insurance lifecycle.
  • Ownership with context: Make decisions with a clear view of customer needs, business priorities, and the teammates who bring the work to market.
  • Growth through scope: Expand your impact through meaningful projects, cross-functional exposure, learning opportunities, and stretch work as the business evolves.
  • Built by people: Work with people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they build, and who share accountability for moving the work forward.

Use the language above as a starting point for consistency and quality. Adjust as needed to fit the role, provided every claim is accurate, current, and tied to the work, team, or business impact.

Benefits and support

Our benefits support your health, time, and life beyond work.

NORTH AMERICA

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Holiday and vacation time
  • Health and wellness days
  • A day off for your birthday

Compensation transparency

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $90,000 USD. Starting pay reflects the role’s scope and the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

Candidate security

Applied communicates with candidates through an @appliedsystems.com email address or our official careers portal. Our recruiters will never request payment or ask for bank account details, government identification numbers, or other sensitive financial information during initial recruiting conversations.

Background checks

Employment is contingent on successful completion of the background checks and verification steps that apply to the role and location.

Use of AI in recruitment

Applied may use AI-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, such as organizing application information, scheduling, and workflow administration. Hiring decisions include human review and follow applicable laws and company policy.

Equal employment opportunity

Applied Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions based on job-related qualifications and business needs, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

The Digital Client Success Manager (DCSM) serves as the primary strategic and operational point of contact for assigned digital marketing clients, ensuring successful campaign execution, strong client relationships, and measurable performance outcomes. The DCSM partners closely with Sales, Creative, Data Operations, Tracking & Attribution, Digital Operations, and Enrollment Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with client enrollment and marketing objectives.

This role plays a critical part in supporting client retention, operational excellence, and long-term account growth by delivering a high-quality client experience, driving strategic value, and ensuring successful digital marketing outcomes across Encoura’s client portfolio.

A Day in the Life

  • Lead the day-to-day management of a portfolio of digital marketing clients and campaigns, serving as the primary point of contact for strategic guidance, campaign updates, and ongoing support

Develop a working knowledge of Encoura’s digital products, systems, and cross-functional collaboration model, and begin independently supporting low-risk operational and campaign tasks.

CLEAR Global is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to having a diverse team where individuals of all backgrounds collaborate and learn from one another. We believe we can be most effective with diverse experience and expertise in our team. We recruit on merit, actively seek diverse applicant pools, and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, marital or parental status, or sexual orientation, and welcome all types of diversity.

Background

CLEAR Global is working with the World Food Programme (WFP) on a pilot project in Uganda, helping to make sure people can access information and services in the language they understand. This pilot depends on building a strong, well-supported network of volunteers, interpreters, and local partners across the languages spoken in Uganda. Getting this right takes hands-on work: training people, reaching out to new volunteers and institutions, mapping where language gaps exist, engaging local partners to use the service, and keeping the community connected and active.

The role

The Tarjimly WFP Uganda Pilot Intern will play an active, on-the-ground role in helping this pilot grow and succeed. This is a varied, practical role: depending on what the pilot needs at any given time, the intern might be helping run a training session one week, reaching out to universities or interpreter networks the next, and helping map language gaps after that. The intern will work closely with the Uganda Field Officer and the wider project team, getting real exposure to how a humanitarian language project is built and run in practice.

This role suits someone who enjoys practical, people-facing work, is comfortable juggling different tasks, and wants hands-on experience helping to build something from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Support training and onboarding: Help prepare and coordinate training and onboarding sessions for volunteers, ambassadors, and potentially partner organizations. This includes helping organize sessions, preparing materials, tracking who takes part, and following up afterwards.
  • Help recruit volunteers and interpreters: Support outreach to find and bring in interpreters and volunteers for the languages needed in the Uganda response, including targeted outreach where gaps are identified.
  • Build partnerships locally: Help identify and reach out to universities, language departments, interpreter networks, professional associations, and other relevant institutions in Uganda that could help strengthen local language capacity and grow the volunteer pool.
  • Support events and community activities: Help plan and run online (and potentially in-person) events connected to the pilot, from early planning and inviting participants through to logistics and following up afterward.
  • Map language capacity and gaps: Help identify which languages are most needed for the pilot, and map where CLEAR Global already has good coverage and where more recruitment or outreach is needed.
  • Build local relationships: Act as a helpful, visible point of contact for volunteers and partners engaging with the pilot in Uganda.
  • Stay flexible and responsive: Move between different areas of the pilot as priorities shift, picking up tasks where support is most needed.
  • Keep track of progress: Maintain clear, simple records of outreach, training, and mapping activities so the wider team can see what's been done and what's next.
  • Other tasks: Take on other tasks connected to the pilot as needed.
  • Represent CLEAR Global well: Act in the best interests of the organization throughout the internship.

Please note that these responsibilities are approximate and may change over time, depending on the evolving needs of the pilot.

Qualifications

  • Current graduate student at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies (MIIS)
  • Familiarity with Uganda, its languages, and its institutions (such as universities or interpreter networks) is an advantage
  • Comfortable reaching out to and building relationships with new people and organizations;
  • Well-organized and able to manage tasks, follow up on actions, and work independently in a remote team;
  • Comfortable using common remote-working and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Meet), Slack and Asana, or similar tools;
  • An interest in humanitarian work, language access, or community mobilization (previous experience is not required, but is a plus);
  • Comfortable learning new tools and software; training and support will be provided.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Requirements

This is a hands-on, varied role, well suited to someone who enjoys practical work and building things from the ground up, rather than a desk-based communications role. The right person is proactive, comfortable talking to new people, and genuinely interested in helping this pilot grow. They should agree with CLEAR Global's basic beliefs and values, and be able to work closely with the Uganda Field Officer and wider project team.

  • Self-starter;
  • Strong organizational skills;
  • Analytical thinker able to transform ideas into tangible actions;
  • Understands that communication in the right language is key to improved humanitarian response;
  • Team player, collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated;
  • Interest in acquiring translation project management experience;
  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn new skills quickly;
  • Attention to detail.

About CLEAR Global

CLEAR Global exists to help people get vital information, and be heard, whatever language they speak. We believe that everyone has the right to give and receive information in a language and format they understand. We work with nonprofit partners and a global community of language professionals to build local language translation capacity, and raise awareness of language barriers. Our network of over 200,000 community members translate millions of words of life-saving and life-changing information a year.

Core values

CLEAR Global employees and volunteers are people who believe passionately about the value of this work and take personal responsibility for achieving the mission. CLEAR Global’s mission and organizational spirit embody the core values established in its strategic framework:

  • Excellence: As the leading voice for communicating humanitarian information in the right language, CLEAR Global is a leader in the translation industry and in the non-profit sector.
  • Integrity: CLEAR Global believes that every person, whether it’s the people who we serve, our volunteers or our staff, has value, deserves respect and has inherent dignity.
  • Empowerment: CLEAR Global believes in using language to empower people around the world to control their own development and destiny.
  • Innovation: CLEAR Global recognizes and celebrates the power of innovation to address humanitarian and crisis issues around the world.
  • Sustainability: CLEAR Global recognizes that meeting our mission necessitates establishment and maintenance of a solid financial and organizational infrastructure.
  • Tolerance: Our staff and volunteers are highly knowledgeable and skilled; value each other, our partner and our recipients; create a supportive work environment; and conduct themselves professionally at all times.

CLEAR Global may re-advertise the vacancy, cancel the recruitment, offer an appointment with a modified job description or for a different duration at its discretion.

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and running on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (GCP, Azure, AWS). We also have engineers working on Prometheus, Grafana Alloy, Mimir proxies, and OpenTelemetry.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our tech stack is mostly made up of services written in Go, running on multiple Kubernetes clusters that leverage Cloud object storage.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

  • Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales (West)

Sales Engineering | United States (Remote) — Pacific, Mountain or Central Region

You'll be the technical lead on Alkira deals — in the room with network architects and infrastructure directors, owning the technical side of the deal from first conversation through POC to close. This is a pre-sales engineering role. You'll partner directly with an Account Manager on strategy and carry real influence over what we build next — our Product team treats SE field feedback as a primary input to the roadmap. It's also a role you can grow in: you'll have senior SEs to learn from, and a clear path for career growth.

Location: Remote, US. Candidates should reside in the Pacific, Mountain or Central time zone for territory coverage.

Travel: approximately 25%, including regional air travel as needed. Please discuss the specifics for this position with the recruiter.

What you'll do

  • Present and demo the Alkira platform to technical decision makers, from engineer to CIO
  • Clearly articulate the Alkira value proposition, with a good understanding of the market, industry and competitive landscape
  • Partner with Alkira Account Managers to understand customer requirements and pain points. Assist with any technical asks from customers and help respond to RFP/RFIs

  • Track and drive key customer features/asks with Alkira Product Management to implementation
  • Contribute to the wider SE team — we review each other's designs, share what works in the field, and build the reusable material the whole team sells with

What you need

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing pre-sales engineering role — Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Architect — ideally at a networking or security vendor, cloud provider, channel partner, or consultancy.
  • Strong networking fundamentals – Everything below builds on this, and it is not negotiable
  • Good working knowledge of routing protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, and static routing, with hands-on experience in route policy design, route redistribution, and filtering
  • Good understanding of network virtualization and software-defined networking, including VRFs, multi-tenant network architectures, SD-WAN, and the encapsulation protocols used to build overlays (GRE, VXLAN, and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, encryption standards, NAT, and secure connectivity architectures
  • Good understanding of how enterprises extend cloud connectivity using a variety of networking technologies (e.g., Cloud On-Ramps, SD-WAN and IPsec)
  • Experience contributing to enterprise network design and deployment across data center, WAN or hybrid/multi-cloud environments
  • Good understanding of network services — DNS, DHCP, load balancing, traffic inspection and similar
  • The ability to troubleshoot in front of a customer across routing, security and cloud domains, with the wider SE team behind you on the hardest problems

Strongly preferred

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to join our MDR team as the founding U.S. member of the Security organization. In this role, you will be part of our security function, focusing on proactive reviews and providing advanced guidance to customers, while independently owning U.S.-hours coverage. This is an opportunity to bring deep cloud security expertise to a fast-growing team, working closely with analysts, researchers, and engineers — with a clear path toward technical or team leadership as the U.S. presence scales.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in fine-tuning Upwind's detection and response mechanisms.
  • Support proactive reviews of customer environments to identify risks, exposed attack surfaces, and recommend improvements.

  • Revenue recognition: Apply ASC 606 to new and amended contracts, including performance obligations, standalone selling price allocation, contract modifications, and variable consideration for usage-based fees.

  • Process improvement: Document procedures, tighten controls, and automate manual steps so the function scales without adding headcount at the same pace.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Explain revenue implications in plain language to non-finance teams and help reduce close-time fire drills.

  • 4–6 years of revenue accounting experience in public accounting and/or a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Hands-on ASC 606 experience with multi-element and usage-based contracts, including SSP analysis and contract modifications.
  • Experience owning a revenue close, including deferred revenue roll-forwards and reconciliations.
  • Comfort with cloud ERP and billing systems (Rillet experience a plus) and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Clear communicator who can explain GAAP to Sales, Legal, and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience with ASC 340-40 deferred commissions.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot CRM and its integration to a revenue sub-ledger.
  • Exposure to SOX scoping or public company readiness work.

Base salary range: $100,000-$130,000

The Director of Compliance will provide strategic leadership over Extend's regulatory compliance function, setting the direction and long-term roadmap for the infrastructure that underpins Extend's service contract and insurance programs across North America, including all licensing. Reporting directly to Extend's VP, Deputy General Counsel, this person will serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to the executive team on regulatory strategy, risk, and governance, representing compliance in front of regulators, auditors, and cross-functional leadership.
