jobs.description:
MOFGA Certification Services, LLC (MCS) is hiring a full time Organic Certification Specialist (Livestock/Dairy focused) to join our team. MCS is a USDA-accredited organic certifier, certifying over 500 crop, livestock, and handling operations in Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts. The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. The ideal candidate will have education and experience in organic regulations, organic and/or sustainable farming methods and production, and familiarity with the various production scopes that MCS certifies. Experience in food processing is a plus. The Certification Specialist reports to the MCS Director and works collaboratively with MCS staff, specialists, and inspectors. This position requires some field work, including inspections, residue sampling, and investigations. Priority will be given to candidates who apply before November 13, 2026

Overview: The Certification Specialist provides high quality customer service along with skilled review and auditing verification to support positive organic certification experiences for organic producers in our service territory, while upholding the USDA National Organic Program regulations. This position assesses compliance of an operation’s organic system plan, reviews inspection reports, and issues subsequent responses, primarily within the livestock and dairy scopes. This position works collaboratively with other certification specialists, inspection program manager, and inspectors, and conducts inspections and pesticide residue sampling as time allows. Certification Specialists also support the MCS quality management system, and may represent MCS at conferences or other MOFGA events. Contributing to MCS policy development, writing pieces for MCS’ newsletter, The Organic Sprout, is an expectation for this position.

Supervisor: Director of MOFGA Certification Services

Position: Salaried. Federal Fair Labor Standards Act exempt. The employee is not eligible for overtime payment. This position is part of the MOFGA Workers United Union bargaining unit.

Work Week: 40 hours - Monday through Friday. Additional evening and weekend hours as required.

Salary Range: This is a salaried position, with a starting salary range of $50,000-$55,000 annually, dependent upon experience. MOFGA has an excellent benefits package, including paid medical, dental and vision insurance, and parental leave. Employees receive a generous paid time off package, including vacation and sick time, three personal days, two week-long office closures, 14 paid holidays annually, and a sabbatical after seven years of employment.

Location: This position is remote, requiring travel within MCS’ service territory, and off-site visits to client’s farms and production facilities. The service territory includes the state of Maine, the state of New Hampshire, and the northeastern areas of Massachusetts. Our offices are located in Unity, Maine and staff are welcome to work from this office as much as they like. Will need to travel to Unity for occasional meetings and required participation in the Common Ground Country Fair. This position is required to be based within the MCS service territory.

Requirements:

  • Education or experience in organic certification or regulatory compliance, including inspections and auditing.
  • Knowledge of the USDA-National Organic Program standards, especially as it applies to crop, livestock/dairy, , and processing.
  • Working knowledge of organic or sustainable crop and livestock farms, dairies, and food processing.
  • A demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, especially in writing.
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Proficiency in computer software, including databases and collaborative platforms.
  • Strong interpersonal skills that welcome collaboration and constructive feedback.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle
  • A commitment to MOFGA’s mission and values.
  • IOIA training and prior organic inspection experience a plus
  • College degree in agriculture or related field a plus
  • Must be able to travel to attend meetings, training workshops and conferences.
  • Participate in MOFGA’s Common Ground Country Fair as needed.

Certification Specialist Responsibilities:

  • Performs certification activities for clients including these specific activities:
    • Perform technical reviews of organic system plans, primarily within the livestock and dairy scope. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Review inspection reports for these same clients. Communicates according to policy with producers about the results of these reviews.
    • Assists applicants by explaining the organic standards and the certification process, encouraging them to take advantage of the technical services offered by MOFGA.
    • Pursues adverse actions with clients in accordance with MCS policy and in coordination with colleagues/supervisors.
    • Keeps track of clients; assures that auditable files are in good order.
  • Conduct annual, investigative and/or unannounced inspections or residue sampling as time allows.
  • Performs material review of products as needed and in conjunction with other MCS staff and agency affiliates.
  • Investigates complaints to protect the integrity of the organic label. Pursues adverse actions, as necessary.
  • Participation in MCS internal audits and NOP accreditation audits.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as deemed necessary to carry out MOFGA’s certification program and maintain accreditation with USDA.

Physical Requirements: Ability to walk long distances over rough terrain; occasional light lifting; ability to drive and travel long distances by car. Able to work in outdoor conditions that include all types of seasonal weather, as well as, inside environments where there may be loud noises or strong odors. Ability to sit for long periods to complete computer-based work, participate in meetings, and conduct organic inspections, whether in person or over video conference platforms.

The Maine Organic Farmers and Gardeners Association (MOFGA) is a broad-based community that supports farmers, empowers people to feed their communities, and advocates for an organic future. Our vision is a future where local organic farming nourishes all people, and sustains thriving ecosystems, healthy communities, and fair economies. MOFGA is committed to creating an inclusive and sustainable workplace that reflects this mission. jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Customer Success and Renewals is a business, sales and solutions thought leader at CDW, responsible for the development and execution of the business unit’s future vision across both the Customer Success and Renewals disciplines. Partnering with sales and solutions and utilizing actionable analytics, this role ensures that Customer Success Managers, Renewal Managers, and supporting roles are delivering to customer outcomes and to retention, renewal, and growth targets. This leader owns the strategies that underpin both functions – the Customer Success lifecycle strategy (Land, Adopt, Expand, Retain) and the renewals strategy that converts adoption into on-time, full-value retention and expansion – and ensures the two operate as one connected motion rather than two hand-offs. The Senior Manager demonstrates focus in leading Managers and Coworkers to achieve financial, operational, and strategic goals, balancing business financials and operational results while maintaining a strong coworker and customer focus. The Senior Manager is a visionary with an objective and pulse on next level customer support, drives strategy, forecasts and evolves the vision of Customer Success and Renewals, understands best in class practices, and inspires innovation. This role is expected to be proficient in the application of AI within the execution of the role, and to define and drive an AI strategy within the team that delivers on the digital strategies required to execute the business unit’s strategy.

What You Will Do

  • Design and drive the business unit’s future vision and strategy across Customer Success and Renewals, aligning the Customer Success methodologies (Land, Adopt, Expand, Retain) and renewals lifecycle (Forecast, Quote, Negotiate, Close, Retain) to ensure both functions operate as one connected motion and are aligned to individual, team, organization, and company goals.
  • Own the renewals strategy for the business unit – forecast accuracy, on-time renewal rate, retention and churn mitigation, multi-year commitments, and expansion – and align it to the adoption strategy so that customer outcomes evidenced through Customer Success drive renewal results.
  • Own the financial management and performance of the Customer Success and Renewals team by defining and managing analytical KPIs across adoption, customer health, renewal rate, on-time renewal, retention, churn, forecast accuracy, and expansion, and deliver against quarterly and long-term financial, operational, and strategic targets.
  • Execute the AI and digital strategy within the Customer Success and Renewals team by prioritizing and adopting relevant use cases, enabling teams to effectively leverage AI and digital capabilities, measuring impact, and ensuring responsible and compliant use.
  • Champion the effective use of the underlying data and digital foundation—including customer health, telemetry, entitlement, and renewal data—to support AI-enabled and digital-led engagement and scale coverage across the team.
  • Be proficient in the use of AI within the execution of the role, applying enterprise AI-enabled tools and insights—such as Copilot, Cowork, and Section Coach—to customer health scoring, renewal forecasting, risk identification, account planning, coworker productivity, and other applicable business needs.
  • Attract, retain, coach, and develop talent by providing meaningful performance feedback, creating individual development plans, and fostering a culture that supports the growth and advancement of internal talent to execute the business unit’s integrated Customer Success and Renewals strategy.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on Customer Success, Renewals, relevant business unit trends, and industry practices, using these insights to evolve the Customer Success and Renewals strategy and drive improved customer outcomes and retention.
  • Develop and execute customer segmentation strategies for the business unit, aligning team resources and engagement models to customer needs, value, and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with sales, OEM and partner organizations, and finance on renewal pricing, quoting, and negotiation strategies that protect margin while demonstrating value to the customer.
  • Enforce best practices, motivate, and influence through a culture of Continuous Quality Improvement.
  • Be an example of our values, The CDW Way, and enforce coworkers to build rapport and corporative relationships with customers and peers while meeting their expectations.


What We Expect of You

Minimum basic requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Management or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in Technology Services or Solutions, with demonstrated expertise in Customer Success, Renewals, Retention, or related customer lifecycle functions.
  • 3+ years of experience building, leading, and managing teams focused on Customer Success, Renewals, or both, including experience leading or partnering closely with renewals, retention, subscription, or contract management functions.
  • Strong understanding of the customer and subscription lifecycle, including customer health and adoption, renewal forecasting, retention and churn metrics, expansion, and contract management practices.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, with the ability to analyze performance, manage financial and operational KPIs, and translate insights into strategies that drive retention, growth, and profitability.
  • Thorough knowledge of operational strategies and enterprise infrastructure, with the ability to translate business and customer needs into strategies that drive customer outcomes, retention, and business performance.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools in a professional setting, including applying AI to daily workflows and coaching teams on effective, responsible, and compliant use.
  • Excellent executive-level interpersonal, written, presentation, consulting, and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively navigate complex or difficult situations, build alignment, and influence customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through complexity, manage high-stress workloads, assess and mitigate risks, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.

Preferred skills, experience and qualities needed

  • Experience with advanced technology solutions and emerging technologies, particularly within a technology services or solutions environment.
  • Applicable Customer Success Management certification(s).
  • Experience defining and deploying an AI or digital adoption strategy within a customer-facing organization.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreJoin a team that puts its People First!
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making

As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

What You'll Do:


Leadership & Team Development

  • Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Data Management & Availability

  • Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
  • Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
  • Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

Tracking & Attribution

  • Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
  • QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
  • Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
  • Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

Testing & Incrementality

  • Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
  • Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
  • Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

Process & Governance

  • Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
  • Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
  • Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

Tools & Technology

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

  • Analytics & Attribution: Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
  • CRM & MAP Systems: Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
  • Tracking & QA: Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
  • Collaboration & Workflow: Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

What You'll Bring:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
  • 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
  • Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
  • Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
  • Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

Mindset

  • Thinks big picture: Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
  • Experimental: Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
  • Forward thinking: Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
  • Acts like an owner: Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
  • Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
  • Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
  • Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

jobs.excerpt: Say hello to HagertyHagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers.
jobs.description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! 

As a Data Engineer II, you will be joining a fast-paced, high functioning team to build and maintain data pipelines and services that support Hagerty’s Enterprise Data Hub (EDH). Internally engineered and developed, the EDH includes data processing & storage, services and APIs. In this role you will develop data pipelines, services, and cloud-based infrastructure to support the growth of Hagerty’s Insurance business and automotive lifestyle brand.

You will be partnering with a team of talented engineers working in an agile environment, leveraging modern cloud-based technologies to drive data-driven decision making in analytics and Hagerty’s data products.

What you’ll do

  • Implement best practices around software development and big data engineering
  • Develop and implement robust and scalable data pipelines using Python, SQL, parallel processing frameworks, and other AWS/Salesforce cloud solutions
  • Develop and implement batch data pipelines using tools such as Apache Airflow, Snowflake, and numerous AWS products (EC2, Fargate, ECS, Lambda, and RDS)
  • Develop streaming data integrations to support products across the Hagerty portfolio and support real-time reporting
  • Develop Enterprise Data Hub platform infrastructure using Terraform infrastructure-as-code
  • Develop and support Hagerty’s cloud-based data warehouse to enable analytics and product reporting
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to collect requirements, recommend best practice solutions, and productionize new data ingestions/analytic workloads
  • Develop solutions to catalog and manage metadata to support data governance and data democratization
  • Partner with Data Quality Engineers to define and implement automated test cases and data reconciliation to validate ETL processes and data quality & integrity
  • Mentor junior team members in software and big data engineering best practices
  • Partner with Data Scientists to design, code, train, test, deploy and iterate machine learning algorithms and systems at scale

This might describe you

  • You have strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • You can authentically and effectively communicate (written and verbally) with various stakeholders
  • You create and share technical artifacts and documentation to support development and maintenance of data products
  • You have experience in successful delivery of data products as productionizable software solutions
  • You ensure quality through rigorous code development, testing, automation, and other software engineering best practices
  • You have experience developing solutions using Python and cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • You demonstrate experience in imperative (e.g., Apache Airflow / NiFi) or declarative (e.g., Informatica/Talend/Pentaho) ETL design, implementation, and maintenance
  • You have functional knowledge of relational databases and query authoring (SQL)

Pluses

  • Associates degree, preferably in a technical/analytical field, or relevant work experience
  • Additional 3+ years working in another role within an IT delivery team, such as a developer, engineer, data analyst, quality assurance analyst, ETL developer or DBA
  • Developing infrastructure as code in a cloud-based environment (Terraform experience preferred)
  • Experience cataloging and processing non-relational data
  • Experience with open-source data processing technologies such as streaming services (Kafka / SQS), big data processing frameworks (MapReduce/Spark), big data file stores (EMRFS / HDFS)
  • Experience working with evaluating different data containers based on workload needs (JSON, delimited files, Avro, Parquet)
  • Experience with container-based development

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • May require travel for quarterly events.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email  for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart. 

At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference.  We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.

This is an evergreen position intended to build a pipeline of qualified candidates for anticipated future openings. While we may not have an immediate vacancy today, we regularly hire for this role and encourage interested candidates to apply so we can connect as opportunities become available.

About the Role

As a Sales Director on our Commercial Sales team you will directly impact the financial success of the organization through the acquisition of new business and the development of strategic customer relationships. You will drive profitable revenue growth by identifying, developing, and closing complex commercial opportunities while positioning Element as a trusted business advisor. Success in this role requires a strong hunter mentality, consultative selling skills, executive presence, financial acumen, risk mitigation, and the ability to lead complex sales opportunities through a structured sales process.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate new business opportunities and acquire new clients within assigned territory and target segments.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline through strategic prospecting, networking, referrals, industry engagement, and outbound business development activities.
  • Lead complex sales opportunities from initial discovery through contract execution and implementation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Risk, Legal, Operations, Implementation, Product, and Client Success to ensure successful deal execution.
  • Conduct executive-level business discussions with C-suite stakeholders, predominantly Finance, Treasury, Procurement, and Operations leaders.
  • Identify strategic business challenges and align Element solutions to measurable operational and financial outcomes.
  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to maximize market penetration, opportunity creation, and long-term revenue growth.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and opportunity management through CRM and sales enablement tools in alignment with Element’s preferred sales framework.
  • Serve as a market expert by identifying industry trends, competitive insights, customer needs, and emerging opportunities that support Element's growth strategy.
  • Remain current on Element’s products and services to effectively position solutions that align with client needs.

​Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or related field required.
  • Minimum 7+ years of successful experience in complex B2B solution sales environments.
  • Minimum of 5 years of sales, customer management, or direct fleet management experience.
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas and revenue objectives.
  • Demonstrated success acquiring new customers through a structured sales methodology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
  • Preferred experience in a financial services customer-facing commercial position.
  • Preferred experience within the vehicle management or a related fleet, financial, or asset-based industry.
  • Experience within fleet management, mobility, transportation, financial services, leasing, business services, or other asset-intensive industries preferred.
  • Experience leveraging Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, or similar sales intelligence platforms.
  • Strong communication, influencing, relationship-building, project management, and critical thinking skills.

Location: Remote Canada

Compensation

The hiring base salary range for this position is $75,000 - $137,500 annually. This range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the expected base salary at the time of posting. Salary ranges may vary based on the geographic location where the work is performed. The salary range listed in this posting applies only to the location identified. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including the successful candidate's qualifications, knowledge, skills, experience, internal pay equity, and relevant market data. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in annual incentive programs, including bonuses, commissions, or other incentive compensation, as applicable to the role. Element also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include health insurance, tuition reimbursement, and retirement savings plans.

By applying, you'll be considered for future opportunities that align with your experience. While there may not be an immediate opening, our recruiting team reviews applications on an ongoing basis and may contact qualified candidates for exploratory conversations, networking opportunities, or future positions as hiring needs arise. Job Summary:

EnvisionWare is hiring an Architect to serve as the technical truth layer for a company-wide AI-first transformation. You will own architectural integrity across a portfolio of 40+ products, use AI to map and interrogate the existing codebase, and validate every AI-generated technical claim before it becomes a decision. This role is the guardrail that makes speed safe. You report into the Director of Engineering and act as architecture authority across the internal team and Contour pod. Contract-to-hire is acceptable if that is the fastest path to the right person. The right candidate has deep systems-thinking capability, practical skepticism about both legacy systems and AI-generated output, and a track record of working close to delivery — not detached from it.

Job Description:

Summary

EnvisionWare is hiring a Principal Architect, Systems & AI to serve as the technical truth layer for a company-wide AI-first transformation. You will own architectural integrity across a portfolio of 40+ products, use AI to map and interrogate the existing codebase, and validate every AI-generated technical claim before it becomes a decision. This role is the guardrail that makes speed safe. You report into the Director of Engineering and act as architecture authority across the internal team and Contour pod. The right candidate has deep systems-thinking capability, practical skepticism about both legacy systems and AI-generated output, and a track record of working close to delivery — not detached from it.

What You'll Own

  • Architectural integrity across all products and major technical changes
  • The architecture approval gate: every design touching system boundaries, auth, payment, or data models requires your sign-off
  • System mapping, dependency analysis, and risk discovery — accelerated by AI but validated by you
  • The modernization roadmap: deciding where to stabilize, modularize, retire, or selectively rewrite
  • Technical guardrails that make AI-assisted development safe at scale

How AI Changes This Role

AI is your force multiplier, not your source of truth. You will use AI to crawl and map unfamiliar codebases, generate dependency views, surface hidden risks, and draft architecture proposals. But every AI-generated technical finding is treated as a hypothesis until you validate it. You set the rules for what AI-generated work requires deeper human review — and you enforce them.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of architecture experience in messy, real-world production environments
  • Legacy modernization expertise — strangler patterns, characterization tests, and the judgment to know when rewrite is justified and when it isn't
  • Multi-stack knowledge: Java, Angular, .NET, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes (or comparable breadth)
  • Ability to understand unfamiliar code quickly and challenge weak assumptions — whether from humans or AI
  • Practical skepticism: you use AI aggressively but trust it only after validation
  • Comfort working close to delivery, code, and teams rather than operating as a detached enterprise architect

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

  • Run an AI-assisted codebase crawl and produce validated system maps and dependency views
  • Classify the portfolio: stabilize, modularize, modernize, retire, or selectively rewrite
  • Define architecture approval rules for cross-boundary changes
  • Validate any AI-generated technical findings before they appear in leadership or roadmap decisions
  • Set the technical guardrails that make AI maturity safe and achievable

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, analyze, and process complex self-funded medical claims from start to finish.

Required:

  • Technical Setup: A secure, HIPAA-compliant home office environment with high-speed internet.

Ideal / Preferred:

  • TPA Experience: Previous experience working within a Third Party Administrator (TPA) environment is highly preferred and will make you a standout candidate.
  • Deep understanding of medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS codes, and standard billing forms (UB-04, CMS-1500).

Why Partner With Us?

  • Total Flexibility: 100% remote work structure from anywhere in the U.S.

Job Description

About Agilent


Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies., Wwe are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, researchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets.


Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation.


The Role


Agilent is seeking a highly experienced global product strategy and innovation leader to help define the future of the laboratory and connect emerging customer, scientific, and technology developments around the world with our product and business strategies.


This individual contributor builds a five- to ten-year perspective, with particular attention to the United States, China, and broader Asian innovation ecosystems. As a recognized internal expert, you will lead high-impact, long-range initiatives, advise senior leadership, and independently address complex challenges across functions with limited support. You will translate global innovation and regional customer insight into actionable priorities for Agilent’s business and product groups.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop a global view of the Lab of the Future. Assess changes in scientific workflows, laboratory operations, customer expectations, competitive dynamics, and technology adoption across geographies and applications. Identify innovations emerging in one market that could reshape laboratory practices worldwide.
  • Establish systematic global innovation sensing through relationships with customers, researchers, start-ups, universities, technology companies, partners, and industry experts. Maintain visibility into the United States, China, broader Asia, Europe, and other strategic regions; identify developments warranting experimentation, partnership, investment, or product action.
  • Partner closely with regional Agilent teams to understand emerging needs, competitors, technologies, and scientific workflows in China and Asia. Translate differences in adoption speed, customer behavior, workflow design, and competitive conditions for global product organizations, and identify opportunities to transfer innovation between regions.
  • Evaluate how AI, machine learning, automation, robotics, and autonomous workflows could change experiment design, instrument operation, data analysis, workflow orchestration, troubleshooting, and service. Assess implications for instruments, software, interfaces, consumables, and services; connect technology choices to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Engage customers globally at the workflow and laboratory level. Identify barriers to productivity, connectivity, and automation that cross product boundaries; distinguish explicit customer requests from emerging needs and turn these observations into clear strategic opportunity areas.
  • Create mechanisms that convert global signals into business-group action. Partner with product leaders on new product concepts, roadmap changes, customer experiments, technology investments, integration priorities, and partnerships. Track strategic opportunities from initial insight through business ownership and execution.
  • Evaluate product and portfolio opportunities for customer value, strategic attractiveness, competitive differentiation, technical feasibility, and global scalability. Develop business cases and recommendations to build, partner, acquire, or invest; identify broader solutions combining Agilent’s instruments, software, automation, services, consumables, and data.
  • Lead initiatives across regional organizations, global product teams, R&D, commercial teams, and senior leadership. Translate between cultural, geographic, and product perspectives to build alignment. Represent Agilent externally with customers, technology partners, researchers, and industry participants.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in science, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. A PhD or equivalent advanced scientific training is strongly preferred; business, strategy, or commercial experience is highly desirable.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant combined experience across scientific research, product strategy, management consulting, product management, business development, commercialization, or related roles.
  • Strong experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, analytical technologies, or laboratory technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating new markets or technologies, translating them into strategic recommendations, and working across multiple geographies or global organizations.
  • Experience engaging customers, scientists, technical organizations, and senior business leaders. Experience with emerging technology, AI, digital transformation, or automation is strongly preferred.

Skills and Competencies


  • Scientific and technical fluency, strategic and analytical problem solving, and strong product and customer judgment.
  • Ability to recognize significant technology shifts, distinguish structural change from hype, and synthesize developments across markets.

Are you excited to break news on the technologies transforming the legal industry?

About our Team

Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. This role can be performed in San Francisco or Los Angeles.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable filing quick-turn stories on major developments in the legal industry and producing deeply reported features and enterprise pieces that put those developments into context.

This reporter will cover one of the most consequential shifts facing the legal industry: the rise of generative AI and the broader transformation of legal services through technology. They should be curious about how AI tools are being adopted, how the technology works, the successes and failures, and what these changes mean for lawyers, clients, courts, regulators, and the economics of the legal profession.

The reporter is expected to cultivate a network of sources across the legal tech ecosystem, including law firm leaders, startup founders, investors, consultants, academics, and regulators. Candidates should have strong news judgment, a proven ability to generate scoops, familiarity with technology and the confidence to chase exclusive reporting in a competitive environment.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

The Credentialing & Provider Enrollment Manager will lead Charlie Health’s credentialing function and the team of specialists responsible for health plan enrollment across Medicaid and Commercial payors. You will own our delegated credentialing program end-to-end — a complex, specialized area spanning provider onboarding, primary source verification, the internal credentialing committee, and required payor and NCQA audits — while setting long-term
credentialing strategy and managing the day-to-day performance of the team.

You will partner cross-functionally with Commercial Strategy, RevOps, RCM, and Compliance to expand delegated credentialing statuses, resolve problem payors, and continuously improve how the team operates, including through automation and AI-enabled tooling. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run a delegated credentialing program before and is excited to both own the details and build the long-term strategy.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

jobs.excerpt: Work From Anywhere in the PhilippinesWork Schedule: PST │ 10:00 AM – 5:00/6:00 PM, synchronous availability required About Pearl TalentPearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU.
jobs.description:
Work From Anywhere in the Philippines

Work Schedule: PST │ 10:00 AM – 5:00/6:00 PM, synchronous availability required

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for:
Watch here:

About the Client

An early-stage healthcare AI company building automation for insurance verification and prior authorization for US surgery centers and hospital systems is looking for an Insurance Verification Specialist to produce structured, checked benefits data and audit the accuracy of its automated output.

Today the company relies on its customers’ verifiers, whose free-text notes are fast but inconsistent and cannot be analyzed at scale. This is the first hire on a small operations and data team, reporting directly to a founder in a lean environment with a 1–2 week onboarding.

About the Role

The Insurance Verification Specialist runs eligibility and benefits checks in US payer portals, calls payers when portal data is missing or unclear, follows prior authorization requests through to approval, and calculates estimated patient responsibility from a written formula. The role also audits the automation’s output against portal and call results, documents payer quirks, and maintains a curated set of checked cases for regression testing. Expected output is about 30 new verifications per day, or 100–200 QA checks per day depending on task mix. Success means every field recorded the same way with evidence attached, unknowns flagged instead of guessed, and mismatches reported with specific, reproducible reasons.

Core Responsibilities

Eligibility & Benefits Verification

  • Run eligibility and benefits checks in US payer portals (UnitedHealthcare, Availity, Waystar, BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Medicare / Medicare Advantage) for scheduled patients.
  • Record each field in a structured form: plan, network status, deductible and out-of-pocket (individual and family, total and met), copay, coinsurance, and prior-auth requirement.
  • Capture the portal PDF or screenshot as evidence for every verification.
  • Mark incomplete or contradictory portal data as unknown instead of guessing.

Payer Calls & Prior Authorization

  • Call payers to verify benefits when the portal is missing or unclear, and confirm whether a procedure (by CPT code) needs prior authorization.
  • Submit prior authorization requests and follow up until approved before the date of service.
  • Log the rep name, call reference number, and outcome in the structured form for every call.
  • Follow client call scripts and record calls as directed.

Patient Responsibility & Data Quality

  • Calculate estimated patient responsibility using the client’s written formula (allowable, deductible, copay, coinsurance, out-of-pocket cap) and document the steps.
  • Audit automated output against portal or call results and flag each mismatch with a one-line reason: automation error, payer data issue, or ambiguous.
  • Give the engineering team specific, reproducible feedback and report patterns across cases.

Documentation & Quality Standards

  • Document payer portal and phone quirks (where a figure lives, which payers need a call, workarounds) as short how-to notes.
  • Build and maintain a curated set of checked cases across payers and plan types for regression testing.
  • Re-check older cases when payer rules change.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 2–5 years of hands-on US insurance eligibility and benefits verification and prior authorization in an ASC, hospital, or RCM/BPO setting, at volume (30+ verifications per day)
  • Daily use of US payer portals such as Availity, UnitedHealthcare, Waystar, or NaviNet
  • Outbound payer phone calls for benefits verification and prior authorization follow-up, with call reference numbers logged
  • Ability to explain deductible, coinsurance, copay, and out-of-pocket maximum, and to calculate a patient-responsibility estimate from them
  • HIPAA training and PHI handling experience
  • English at C1+ CEFR (written) and B2+ CEFR (spoken)
  • Availability for synchronous work 10:00 AM – 5:00/6:00 PM Pacific Time

Nice-to-Have

  • Verification experience in surgical specialties: GI, ophthalmology, orthopedics, pain management, or ENT
  • Medicare Advantage and secondary-coverage case experience
  • Experience auditing or QA-ing automated or AI-generated output
  • SQL, data-labeling, or advanced spreadsheet experience
  • Experience working with minimal supervision, such as sole verifier, writing SOPs, or training others

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees
  • Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application
  2. Screening
  3. Skills Assessment
  4. Topgrading Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Job Offer
  7. Client Onboarding

If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

jobs.description:
The Role

The External Event Marketing Manager is responsible for leading the execution of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 third-party event portfolio. This role serves as a key member of the External Event Strategy team, translating event strategies into flawless onsite execution and measurable business results. The manager partners closely with Sales, Product, Partner Marketing, Communications, and agency teams to deliver exceptional event experiences while owning planning, operations, logistics, staffing, and onsite production. 

Acting as a versatile "pinch hitter" across programs, this individual develops planning documents, builds scalable event processes, manages agency partners, oversees ancillary event production, and serves as an onsite leader responsible for execution excellence from planning through post-event reporting. Success in this role requires strong project management, attention to detail, cross-functional collaboration, and a willingness to take ownership and lead under pressure. 

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end execution for Tier 1 and Tier 2 third-party events, ensuring programs are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned to business objectives. 
  • Support the External Event Strategy lead in executing portfolio plans and bringing event strategies to life across key industry programs. 
  • Own event planning documentation, timelines, project plans, run-of-shows, staffing schedules, and execution workstreams. 
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact and manager for event agencies, vendors, venues, and production partners. 
  • Lead onsite event execution, managing logistics, stakeholder engagement, staffing, issue resolution, and overall event operations. 
  • Develop and manage event staffing plans, ensuring resources are effectively deployed before, during, and after events. 
  • Produce ancillary events, including customer dinners, executive roundtables, receptions, hospitality programs, meeting experiences, and partner engagements that complement event objectives. 
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Sales, Product Marketing, Communications, Brand, IT, and Partner Marketing to drive seamless execution and customer experiences. 
  • Create and maintain scalable event processes, templates, and planning tools to improve operational efficiency across the portfolio. 
  • Manage event budgets, timelines, and vendor deliverables while ensuring adherence to brand standards and organizational requirements. 
  • Track event results and contribute to post-event reporting, insights, and recommendations for future program improvements. 
  • Identify opportunities to enhance attendee engagement and deliver innovative activations that extend beyond traditional booth experiences.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of professional experience, or 6+ years with a Master's degree. 
  • 5+ years of experience executing large-scale third-party events, conferences, trade shows, or experiential marketing programs. 
  • Experience supporting major industry events such as AWS re: Invent, Microsoft Ignite, Cisco Live, Gartner Symposium, Mobile World Congress, or similar programs. 
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex event workstreams simultaneously with exceptional attention to detail. 
  • Experience developing project plans, staffing schedules, run-of-show documents, production timelines, and operational frameworks. 
  • Experience managing event agencies, vendors, production partners, and venue relationships. 
  • Demonstrated success leading onsite event operations and serving as the primary event producer in high-pressure environments. 
  • Experience planning and executing ancillary events including customer receptions, executive engagements, hospitality programs, and networking experiences. 
  • Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Marketing, Communications, and executive leadership teams. 
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous or rapidly changing priorities. 
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 25-40%. 

Preferred

  • Agency experience preferred; Telecom background; B2B Marketing experience; event production, partner marketing, and 8+ years of experience 

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $105,786 - $193,940. Your actual base salary and level will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, education, and location.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa (e.g., H-1B) now or in the future. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

About Alkira

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload. Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

Frontend Engineer (Mid-Level)

Who is Parser?

Technology alone does not create impact—the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East. We combine global reach with a mindset focused on agility, senior expertise, and close collaboration.

We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions, and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.

Why Join Us?

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.

How will you impact?

As a Mid-Level Frontend Engineer, you will own consumer-facing web features end-to-end within a microfrontend ecosystem. Your work directly drives organic acquisition and user experience through web performance optimizations, seamless right-to-left localization, and reliable product delivery.

Your key responsibilities:

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Build and ship responsive, mobile-first user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js across server- and client-rendered applications.
  • Develop reusable design system components supporting multi-country configuration, internationalisation, and right-to-left (RTL) Arabic layouts.
  • Optimize web performance and Core Web Vitals, including bundle size, hydration costs, rendering paths, image/font loading, and caching strategies.
  • Maintain robust application contracts and shared libraries across microfrontend architectures.
  • Implement reliable analytics tracking, feature flags, and unit, component, and end-to-end testing (using Playwright and Storybook).
  • Utilize production signals, real-user monitoring, and error tracking tools to proactively resolve performance and user-facing issues.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, SEO, and backend teams, delivering thoughtful code reviews and engineering improvements.

What you’ll bring to the role:

Essential Requirements:

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience delivering and operating production web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern state/data-fetching patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG, routing, server vs. client-side execution).
  • Solid foundation in semantic HTML, CSS Modules/responsive layout systems, and web accessibility fundamentals.
  • Practical experience with API integration, unit/component testing, and automated E2E testing (Playwright preferred).
  • Proven understanding of Core Web Vitals, web performance measurement, and debugging techniques.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with microfrontend architectures, monorepos, or shared npm packages.
  • Hands-on experience with internationalisation (i18n), right-to-left (RTL) layouts, and SEO-driven products.
  • Exposure to frontend observability, tag management, feature flagging, or geospatial/maps APIs.

Location:

Spain (Remote) Candidates must be able to accommodate UAE working hours.

You will receive:

  • The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A highly competitive compensation package.
  • A flexible and hybrid working environment.
  • Medical insurance.

Parser is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.

By applying to this role, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with Parser’s Privacy Notice for recruitment purposes.

Parser may use AI-assisted tools during certain stages of the recruitment process to support operational efficiency. Our recruiting teams use AI to streamline note-taking and scheduling. All hiring decisions are made by people, with human review and oversight.

jobs.description:
About Emplicit

Emplicit is a results-driven ecommerce agency that combines omnichannel marketing with marketplace management. We partner with consumer brands to grow sales across Amazon (US, CA, UK, EU) and marketplaces such as TikTok Shop, Walmart, and Target. We build strategy, run media, optimize catalogs and content, and deploy advanced reporting and automation to drive measurable ecommerce outcomes.

Role Summary

We're not looking for a relationship babysitter. We're looking for a commercially-minded strategist who understands the Amazon ecosystem, thinks like a Business Director, and isn't afraid to challenge a client's C-suite when the strategy needs to change.

You'll own a portfolio of 18–25 brands — the majority selling on Amazon, with some on Walmart and TikTok Shop. Your job is to retain them, grow them, and turn them into Emplicit advocates. You will be backed by a dedicated, cross-functional pod of Marketing Managers and Coordinators to ensure you can stay focused on high-level strategy, not day-to-day data entry.

That means real relationships. C-suite trust. Proactive conversations before problems surface. Upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch. And the commercial instincts to know when to push and when to listen. AI gives you an edge — but the calls, the trust, and the revenue are yours to win.

Reports to the Director of Client Success & Partnerships.

Remote - US Time Zones

What you’ll own

Client Relationships & Retention

  • Own a portfolio of 18–25 high-growth Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop brands—retaining them, scaling them, and turning them into brand advocates.
  • Build genuine C-suite relationships across every account — the kind of trust that makes clients call you first
  • Multi-thread across 3–5 stakeholders per client — Champion, Decision Maker, Influencer
  • Proactively identify and address churn risk before it becomes a conversation you didn't see coming
  • Convert satisfied clients into public advocates — targeting one case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Revenue & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and close upsell opportunities across your full portfolio — upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch
  • Build Scopes of Work (SOWs) and business cases for service expansions
  • Shift client perception from "cost" to "investment" through data-backed ROI storytelling
  • Own P&L and revenue forecasting for your accounts
  • Lead onboarding for 2+ new brands per month, from handoff through go-live

Strategy & Internal Leadership

  • Run forward-looking QBRs that drive strategy, not just recap performance
  • Challenge client assumptions with a Challenger mindset — prescribe strategic pivots even when it's a hard conversation
  • Direct Marketing Managers and Project Coordinators toward unified client goals — you set the mission, they execute the tactics
  • Orchestrate the onboarding journey for incoming brands, partnering closely with Project Coordinators to build a flawless operational foundation and establish immediate authority with the client.
  • Serve as the ultimate Pod Leader for the cross-functional team assigned to your accounts. You don't just run weekly meetings and monthly reviews; you own the pod's cultural and operational alignment, actively surfacing team-identified upsell leads and transforming them into a healthy pipeline.
  • Partner with our ops team to help shape the AI and automation tools that make this role scalable — from churn-risk flagging to proposal workflows

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Stakeholder roadmaps and Joint Success Plans underway for your full portfolio

● 2+ new brands onboarded per month

  • First upsell opportunities identified and in active proposal stage
  • Genuine relationships established with C-suite contacts at every account

Ongoing KPIs

  • 95%+ client satisfaction across your portfolio
  • 5+ upsell opportunities presented monthly; 2–3 closed per month.

● 2–3 new SOWs completed per month

  • Active multi-threaded relationships across 100% of accounts
  • One public case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Must have

  • You possess high emotional intelligence and excel at turning tense client situations into wins. You don't just manage accounts; you build indispensable strategic partnerships, resulting in industry-leading client retention and advocacy.
  • Amazon fluency: Seller Central, TACoS, BSR, Buy Box — you understand the deep cause-and-effect relationship between these marketplace levers and your client’s bottom line. You are "fluent" because you know how to manipulate these elements to protect client margins, prevent costly listing disruptions, optimize ad spend against total profitability, and strategically scale their market share.
  • You have a proven history of spotting untapped revenue within existing portfolios. You know how to align a client's business goals with our additional services, seamlessly introducing upsells and cross-sells that drive mutual growth.
  • You act as a trusted consultant, not an order-taker. You are comfortable challenging a client’s assumptions, steering them away from poor marketplace strategies, and backing up your recommendations with hard data and industry insights.
  • You operate like the CEO of your book of business. You focus on lagging indicators like net revenue retention (NRR) and portfolio profitability, proactively identifying risks and pivot strategies before they affect the bottom line.
  • You can distill complex Amazon data into clear, high-level narratives for executive stakeholders. Whether you are drafting a watertight SOW or commanding a boardroom QBR, your delivery is polished and persuasive. Crucially, you possess a sharp commercial lens and act as the strategic bridge between the client and our internal delivery teams—masterfully delegating and guiding internal resources to champion the client’s goals while aggressively driving our company’s bottom line.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Walmart Connect or TikTok Shop advertising
  • Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Intentwise, or Merchant Springs
  • HubSpot power user — CRM hygiene, pipeline management, automations
  • Prior agency experience — you understand the pace and P&L realities

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI productivity tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) beyond basic chat functions. Ideally, you have experience building custom agents, automating workflows, or managing AI-driven projects—or you possess a fierce curiosity to learn how.
  • Experience helping build internal processes, playbooks, or automation workflows from scratch

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus tied to upsell revenue you generate

● Healthcare (medical/dental/vision)

● 401k with employer match

● Remote, flexible PTO

  • Budget for training & professional development
Salary: $85,000 – $95,000 / year
