jobs.title: Director, Labeling and Nutrition Compliance
jobs.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

The Food Safety and Quality Assurance team helps ensure CookUnity’s meals meet food safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Working across Culinary, Supply Chain, Procurement, Nutrition & Standards, Food Science Lab, Legal, Marketing, Design, Product, Engineering, and Operations, the team supports accurate product information and consistent execution across our markets.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Director of Labeling and Nutrition Compliance to lead labeling and nutrition compliance across our meals, ingredient data, product claims, and customer-facing information.

You will own the overall source-to-label process, including governance, performance metrics, third-party laboratory validation, and approval of product and nutrition claims. You will establish technical acceptance criteria, verify data suitability, coordinate cross-functional deliverables, and manage the label and content release process, withholding approval when supporting evidence is insufficient.

This role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to lead within a cross-functional organization. You will establish clear accountability, verify nutrition and labeling information, and ensure teams have practical controls for maintaining compliance as ingredients, recipes, suppliers, systems, and markets evolve.

Within your first 90 days, you will establish technical acceptance criteria and a risk-ranked review baseline, verify a representative set of supplier and market substitutions delivered by Supply Chain, and demonstrate an independently reviewed, controlled release pilot that includes label-to-website reconciliation. You will also align ongoing verification and escalation measures with functional owners, while Supply Chain retains ownership of the data remediation plan and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead CookUnity’s labeling and nutrition compliance program. Establish practical standards consistent with applicable Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA) requirements for ingredient declarations, allergens, Nutrition Facts, serving sizes, net quantity, claims, required statements, and market-specific labeling, in partnership with Nutrition & Standards.

  • Own the create, review, approve, and distribute (CRAD) labeling process, governance, and consolidated KPI dashboard. Define functional accountability, independent review requirements, approval records, version controls, release criteria, escalation paths, and corrective-action follow-through.

  • Define regulatory and technical requirements for ingredient master data owned by Supply Chain Operations. Lead the specification approval and stakeholder sign-off process, including supplier-item and market specificity, source evidence, approved substitutions, and acceptance criteria.

  • Review and approve ingredient data eligibility for labeling and claims, tracking and escalating unresolved dependencies.

  • Own third-party laboratory validation, including lab qualification, risk-based representative sampling across suppliers and markets, appropriate testing methods, and comparison against approved recipes, portions, declared nutrition, and claim criteria.

  • Investigate laboratory discrepancies and drive verified corrections through the accountable data, recipe, or execution owner.

  • Approve product, nutrition, standards, ingredient, and dietary claims before publication across channels. Require substantiation, approved wording, applicability and conditions, review dates, and change control.

  • Obtain documented Food Science Lab approval of the nutritional basis for claims, required Legal concurrence, and appropriately qualified clinical approval of medically tailored meal criteria.

  • Set risk-based technical review priorities for estimated and generic legacy records. Partner with Supply Chain, which owns data remediation and maintenance, to verify corrections, assess supplier and market equivalence, and confirm impacts on recipes, nutrition values, allergens, and claims.

  • Manage the compliance impact of supplier, ingredient, recipe, process, portion, packaging, and system changes. Require affected products and claims to be reassessed before release, including substitutions and market-specific variants.

  • Establish technical acceptance criteria for labeling and data systems. Partner with Engineering to verify source-to-label and website field mappings, controlled synchronization, and automated completeness, calculation, rounding, and version checks.

  • Require production first-article checks and ongoing label-to-meal verification. Partner with Operations and Supply Chain on approved masters, effective dates, acknowledgment of changes, and removal of obsolete labels and templates.

  • Verify consistency between approved label master data and customer-facing channels, including the CookUnity website, for ingredients, allergens, nutrition values, serving details, and claims.

  • Define website reconciliation criteria and verify publication and correction evidence. Partner with Growth Marketing/SEO, which owns website accuracy, publishing, discrepancy correction, and the website parity KPI, and escalate safety or compliance discrepancies through the incident process.

  • Exercise delegated authority to hold or reject nonconforming label and content releases. Ensure independent review of technical work you prepare and escalate product holds, disposition decisions, and unresolved safety or compliance issues to the VP of FSQA under established procedures.

  • Maintain inspection-ready records and train cross-functional teams on labeling requirements, approval workflows, and operating controls.

  • Maintain the overall CRAD KPI dashboard covering technical data acceptance, Culinary recipe and portion conformity, laboratory-versus-declared accuracy, claims compliance, release performance, defects, and corrective actions. Incorporate Growth Marketing/SEO’s website parity and coverage results, coordinate functional delivery, and escalate gaps while each function owns its evidence, results, and corrective actions.

  • Drive a consistent process in which released products have traceable inputs, supported claims, documented independent review, approved market-specific labels, consistent website content, and verified production execution.

Qualifications

  • Deep, practical experience in food-labeling regulations, nutrition, and standards compliance, including hands-on technical review of packaged food labels, ingredient and allergen declarations, nutrition calculations, and claim substantiation.

  • Strong working knowledge of applicable U.S. FDA food-labeling requirements and the ability to determine when USDA FSIS or other market requirements apply, with qualified specialist support as needed.

  • Experience connecting supplier specifications, ingredient databases, formulations, recipe systems, nutrition analysis, artwork, and production execution through controlled workflows.

  • Sound technical judgment regarding ingredient variability, cooking yields, portioning, laboratory results, and the limitations of calculated nutrition.

  • Ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into clear acceptance criteria and practical operating controls.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional programs, resolving ownership gaps, and implementing change without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clear written communication, careful documentation, and confidence holding a release when supporting evidence is incomplete.

  • A degree in food science, nutrition, regulatory science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in multi-site prepared meal operations.

  • Experience with recipe-management systems and supplier-data platforms.

  • Familiarity with Canadian food-labeling requirements.

  • Registered Dietitian credentials. Clinical standards and medically tailored meal criteria require appropriately qualified expertise.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

The role

The Learning Designer role at Valenture Institute is primarily responsible for designing, developing and quality assuring secondary school course content and learning activities for online delivery, in line with curriculum requirements, SACAI requirements and Valenture’s internal learning design standards. The incumbent is responsible for delivering high-quality course content within agreed scope and timelines, and for ensuring that their work meets the required curriculum, quality and learning design standards.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:

As our Senior Talent Operations Specialist at Airalo, you will own the systems, data, and processes that help recruiters and hiring managers hire efficiently. You will turn complex workflows into scalable processes, make sure our hiring data is reliable, and give leaders the insights they need to plan headcount with confidence.

You are someone who sees a manual step and wants to automate it, sees a messy dataset and wants to fix it at the source, and sees a new tool and asks how we can best equip it. You are equally at ease configuring an ATS, running a training session for interviewers, and presenting funnel insights to business leaders.

You will work in close coordination with our Talent Acquisition team, People team, Finance, Legal, and IT, as the processes and systems you build need to work for every region we hire in.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Own the configuration, administration, and optimization of our ATS and wider recruiting tech stack, including integrations
  • Evaluate, implement, and retire tools, and manage the vendors behind them
  • Build automations that remove manual work from talent team members' days
  • Design, document, and continuously improve end-to-end hiring workflows, from requisition approval to onboarding handoff
  • Keep hiring practices consistent across regions and compliant with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR)
  • Build dashboards and reports on funnel conversion, time to hire, source effectiveness, and pipeline health, and keep ATS data reliable
  • Translate data into recommendations for Talent and business leaders, including support on headcount planning
  • Maintain guides, templates, and training so recruiters and hiring managers can self-serve, and lead change management for new tools and processes
  • Mentor more junior team members and make sure every candidate gets a smooth, respectful process
  • Support recruitment as needed, particularly during peak hiring periods

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years in recruitment operations, talent acquisition, or People Ops, with significant hands-on ATS administration (Lever or a comparable ATS)
  • Proven experience building recruiting reports and turning the data into clear recommendations
  • Proven experience building automations or integrations that remove manual work from recruiting workflows
  • Proven experience leading change management and delivering enablement, including training and documentation
  • Working knowledge of data privacy requirements in hiring (e.g., GDPR) across regions
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Excellent written communication and documentation skills; business-fluent English
  • Skilled in using AI to improve recruiting workflows and reporting while protecting candidate data and mitigating bias

Good to have:

  • Experience with Notion, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Metaview
  • Experience with workflow automation tools
  • Experience in a fast-moving environment such as a startup or scale-up
  • Additional languages alongside English

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here:
We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

jobs.title: L1 SOC ANALYST
jobs.excerpt: About The RoleKVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States.
jobs.description:
About The Role

KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.

This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.
  • Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.
  • Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.
  • Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.
  • Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.
  • Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.
  • Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.
  • Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.
  • Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.
  • Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.
  • Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.
  • Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.
  • Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.
  • The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.
  • Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.
  • CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

  • Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG.
  • A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.
  • A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.
  • Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.
  • European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies

Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

jobs.excerpt: About UsAll Care To You is a Management Service Organization providing our clients with healthcare administrative support.
jobs.description:
About Us

All Care To You is a Management Service Organization providing our clients with healthcare administrative support. We provide services to Independent Physician Associations, TPAs, and Fiscal Intermediary clients. ACTY is a modern growing company which encourages diverse perspectives. We celebrate curiosity, initiative, drive and a passion for making a difference. We support a culture focused on teamwork, support, and inclusion. Our company is fully remote and offers a flexible work environment as well as schedules.

ACTY offers 100% employer paid medical, vision, dental, and life coverage for our employees. Additional employee paid coverage options available. We also offer paid holidays, birthday off, and unlimited PTO as well as a 401k plan.

Job purpose

The position of UM Outpatient Review Nurse reports to the Director, Case Management. The position of UM Outpatient Review Nurse is part of the Case Management team and is responsible for clinical, quality, and patient outcomes. This position is expected to implement the effectiveness and best practices of Utilization Review and will provide high quality medical review by appropriately applying the State, Federal, health plan and clinical guidelines used to determine medical necessity.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Review authorization requests for medical necessity, determines which requests need Medical Director review, obtains sufficient medical documentation for an informed consent.
  • Process all requests within established time frames.
  • Documents all steps of process in authorization system in the authorization notes.
  • Utilizes CMS and Health Plan Hierarchy criteria.
  • Clinical documentation, specific criteria, and record attachment for referral prior to sending to the Medical Director for review.
  • Retrospective review of services to determine medical necessity.
  • Refer cases to the Medical Director for review of requests that may not meet medical necessity criteria.
  • Process denials within established timeframes.
  • Writes denial letters to meet CMS and Health Plan requirements.
  • Work closely with other MSO team members as necessity requires.
  • Applies the appropriate clinical criteria/guideline, policy, EOC/benefit policy and clinical judgment to render coverage determination/recommendation for the review process.
  • Review member’s utilization and claim history when processing a referral.
  • Maintain quality reviews while meeting the established TATs for Urgent, Routines and Retro requests.
  • Maintains Interrater Reliability Rate at least 95% or above.
  • Daily production standard is a minimum of 50-90 referrals/day depending on complexity with accuracy & quality.
  • Makes approval determinations when request meets appropriateness, medical necessity and benefit criteria.
  • Utilizes clinical experience and skills in a collaborative process to assess, plan, implement, coordinate, monitor and evaluate options to facilitate appropriate healthcare services that meet criteria and can be authorized by a nurse level reviewer.
  • Act as clinical resource to all departments.
  • Communicates with health plans, providers, members and other parties to facilitate member care treatment plans.
  • Participating in team training
  • Comply with UM policies and procedures. Annual review of UM policies. Attend to provider and interdepartmental calls in accordance with exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to keep high level of confidence and discretion when dealing with sensitive matters relating to providers, and members. Always maintains strict confidentiality.
  • Other duties as needed.

Qualifications

  • A valid CA and Texas/Multi State Registered Nurse license or Licensed Vocational Nurse
  • CM and/or UM training and/or certification. Knowledge of CM standards, UM standards, Clinical Standards of Care, NCQA requirements, CMS guidelines, Milliman guidelines, and InterQual guidelines. Medi-Cal, Commercial and Medicare contracts and benefit interpretation is preferred.
  • Five years+ clinical experience.
  • Prefer of two (2) years+ experience in an HMO/IPA/Managed care setting is preferred and recommended.
  • Must be available to work weekends and holidays, as business needs require.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, exercising judgment and initiative.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks with effective prioritization.
  • Proficiency using Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Microsoft Office (including Word and Excel) and Adobe
  • Must be available to work weekends and holidays, as business needs require.
  • Detail oriented and highly organized
  • Strong ability to multi-task, project management, and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong ability in problem-solving
  • Ability to manage self-manage, strong time management skills.
  • Ability to work in an extremely confidential environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Education and Additional Requirements

  • Holds Current Unrestricted CA and Texas/Multi State RN or LVN license
Salary: $70,000 - $120,000 annually

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote (U. S.  and globally) or in-person at ELAW’s office in Eugene, Oregon USA.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (U.S. and globally) or in-person at ELAW’s office in Eugene, Oregon USA.

Candidates should indicate whether they intend to work remotely, or from ELAW’s Eugene office. The Eugene office is a historic building. In-person internships may include additional opportunities to interact with visiting lawyers.

Timing: 10 weeks between late May and September 2027 (full-time, ~40 hours/week). We are open to considering a different timeframe to accommodate other academic schedules. If you need a different timeframe, please clearly describe that in your application materials.

Eligibility: Open to students enrolled in or who have recently completed a graduate-level studies in environmental science. International applicants with equivalent science education are welcome to apply and should describe how their academic or professional background prepares them to succeed in this role.

The Science internship with the ELAW Science Program team involves communication in English. For applicants from non-English speaking countries, we will work with applicants to identify the best method of establishing proof of English language proficiency (including but not limited to TOEFL or IELTS scores, or enrollment in an English-speaking LLM, as proof of English language proficiency). Spanish or French as a first language or proficiency is a welcome asset.

Compensation: While applicants are encouraged to seek funding through school grants or external scholarships, financial aid status is never considered during candidate selection. ELAW will supplement external funding to guarantee that all interns receive a total rate of $17.50 per hour for 10 weeks of full-time work (up to $7,000 total).

Who We Are

Environmental Law Alliance Worldwide (ELAW) is an international NGO, registered in Oregon as a nonprofit. At ELAW, we believe that environmental protection and human rights are inseparable—and that the best solutions come from those closest to the problem. That’s why we support a global network of public interest lawyers and scientists in 80+ countries working to protect communities and ecosystems through law.

The Science & Economics team delivers timely scientific and economic expertise to global public interest advocates in pursuit of environmental justice. We respond to individual requests from public interest environmental lawyers on a broad range of topics, including public health, ecology, air and water quality, marine environments, natural resources, and climate science.

As a Science & Economics Intern, you’ll directly support these efforts—gaining hands-on experience, dedicated mentorship, and global exposure while empowering communities with science-backed arguments for systemic change. Learn more at .

What You’ll Do

Over the course of your internship, you will:

  • Conduct science research and draft memos on a wide range of scientific topics.
  • Analyze and summarize studies in the peer-reviewed scientific literature.
  • Assist with drafting of memos that answer questions pertaining to environmental science for use in submissions to courts and administrative agencies. briefs, regulatory analyses, or resource updates;
  • Participate as a collaborative member of a science team that supports interns through meaningful mentorship; and
  • Observe strategic and information gathering meetings with local lawyer partners;

Recent intern projects have included:

  • Evaluation of environmental impact assessments to identify deficiencies that might be grounds for rejecting approval of environmentally harmful projects.
  • Interpretation of air and water quality data to identify levels that pose risks to human health of wildlife and that might exceed health-based and ecological-based environmental standards

Who Thrives in This Internship

Successful interns tend to be:

  • Deeply committed to public interest environmental justice, and human rights;
  • Curious, meticulous researchers who write clearly and think critically;
  • Collaborative and communicative, but self-directed in managing time and projects;
  • Adaptable and open-minded, eager to learn across legal systems and cultures; and
  • Multilingual or bring lived experience from frontline or underrepresented communities (preferred but not required)

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful Scientific Contribution: You complete high-quality research and writing that directly supports frontline legal partners.
  • Strong Mentorship Relationships: You build supportive, lasting connections with ELAW scientists who care deeply about your growth.
  • Clarity on Career Path: You leave with insight into your values, your place in the global environmental justice movement, and what comes next.
  • Positive Community Impact: Your work contributes to legal tools to better protect those defending the environment.

What Makes This Internship Unique

  • Global Exposure: Interns engage with the use of scientific information in environmental advocacy with partners in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and beyond.
  • Hands-On Experience: This is not a siloed research position—you’ll work on live issues and real-world advocacy.
  • Movement-Aligned Mentorship: Interns receive clear supervision, collaborative feedback, and intentional support.
  • A Mission-Driven Team: Our team is collaborative, inclusive, and grounded in shared values—not just expertise.
  • Remote Flexibility with Real Connection: Whether remote or in Eugene, interns are included in meetings, team communications, and one-on-one check-ins.

How to Apply

Please submit one PDF file that includes the following documents in this order:

  1. Cover letter (1 page) describing your interest in ELAW and this opportunity, what you hope to gain from the internship, and relevant experiences or skills
  2. Resume or CV
  3. Legal writing sample (10 pages max)

Apply by October 23, 2026

Note: We may send updates via BambooHR. Please monitor your inbox (including spam/junk folders) for messages from us.

Our Commitment to Equity

We actively seek interns from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from those historically underrepresented in the legal field.

We recognize that unpaid or underfunded internships create barriers for many students. To expand access, ELAW offers fully remote, 10-week full-time internships compensated at $17.50 per hour (up to $7,000 total).

We do not expect all candidates to follow the same academic or professional path. If your experience doesn't match our eligibility criteria exactly but you’ve completed rigorous science education that you believe is equivalent to two years of graduate-level science education — we encourage you to explain in your cover letter how your background prepares you to succeed in this internship.

ELAW is committed to equity, inclusion, and justice in our work and in our workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, immigration status, sexual orientation, or any other protected identity.

jobs.description:
The Leidos Health and Services Sector Chief Product Office has an opening for a Backend Software Engineer to support the Health Data Extraction (HDE) product effort.

The successful candidate will design, develop, test, and maintain cloud-based backend services that process healthcare documents and data. This role combines strong software engineering skills with practical experience integrating artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, and document-processing capabilities into production applications.


The engineer will work within a cross-functional product team to transform structured and unstructured healthcare information into reliable, standards-based data products. This is primarily a software engineering and product development role, rather than a research-focused data science position.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-processing workflows supporting the HDE product.
  • Develop production-quality Python software for document ingestion, processing, clinical data extraction, validation, enrichment, and delivery.
  • Integrate generative AI, NLP, OCR, and other machine-learning services into secure and reliable backend applications.
  • Convert product requirements, technical specifications, and data contracts into maintainable software components.
  • Build and support RESTful APIs and event-driven processing workflows.
  • Process structured and unstructured healthcare data and produce consistent, standards-based outputs.
  • Implement automated unit, integration, and regression tests to protect product quality and prevent defects.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, data, performance, and integration issues across distributed cloud services.
  • Improve application reliability through structured logging, monitoring, error handling, retries, and operational metrics.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted extraction results and help implement validation, grounding, confidence scoring, and quality-control mechanisms.
  • Optimize services for performance, scalability, resilience, and cost.
  • Protect sensitive healthcare information by following applicable security, privacy, and data-handling requirements.
  • Participate in design discussions, code reviews, estimation, sprint planning, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Work independently on moderately complex assignments while coordinating with software engineers, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, product managers, and domain specialists.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous improvement of the development process.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, with 4+ years of relevant professional experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Professional software development experience using Python or a comparable backend programming language.
  • Experience developing and supporting production backend services, APIs, or data-processing applications.
  • Understanding of object-oriented and modular software design, data structures, error handling, and maintainable coding practices.
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON-based data contracts, and asynchronous or event-driven processing.
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and managed services, preferably AWS.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models or managed AI services into software applications.
  • Working knowledge of NLP, document processing, generative AI, or information-extraction concepts.
  • Experience writing automated tests and troubleshooting software across development and deployed environments.
  • Experience using Git and participating in collaborative development and code-review workflows.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: About NscaleAt Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution.
jobs.description:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centers and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers — including Microsoft and NVIDIA — Nscale integrates next-generation compute hardware and Next GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across North America, Europe, and beyond.

About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Pipeline Engineering to own the engineering of the natural gas transmission pipelines that fuel Nscale's generation campuses, from upstream interconnect to plant fence.

Nscale's Power and Energy group develops behind-the-meter generation colocated with our data center campuses: large reciprocating engine fleets served by dedicated, large-diameter gas transmission pipelines moving hundreds of millions of cubic feet per day. These are not ordinary laterals. The pipeline is also the storage: line pack is the operating inventory that buffers nominations against engine demand, pressure is governed by that inventory balance, and the design of overpressure protection, regulation, and system controls determines whether gigawatts of compute stay online. Much of this work is closer to process engineering than to conventional pipeline design, and this role owns it.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role built for someone who runs with minimal oversight. You will establish the design basis for our pipelines and demonstrate how it ties to our downstream commitments — engine demand, swing, and availability — drive the engineering through hydraulic design, controls philosophy, and construction, and technically manage the third-party engineering firms and pipeline construction contractors doing the work. Lines are in delivery today and new lines will follow, so the role owns both the systems being built now and the reference engineering for what comes next.

You will sit within the Power and Energy technology organization, working alongside the generation engineering and commissioning teams that depend on the gas you deliver. You will be the owner's technical authority on the pipeline scope, directing the work of consultants and contractors rather than simply accepting it, and resolving the design questions where standard midstream practice does not account for a single customer whose demand can swing with AI workloads.

Location: Houston, TX (remote considered within the US, with regular site and vendor travel)

What You'll Be Doing

Pipeline system engineering and design basis

  • Own the design basis for Nscale's gas transmission pipelines: hydraulic design, MAOP and pressure regime, line pack and inventory strategy, routing and sizing philosophy, and expansion provisions for future lines.
  • Perform and direct steady-state and transient hydraulic modeling of the pipeline systems, and own the models as living engineering assets that answer real operating questions: inventory swing, survival time on line pack, ramp response, and curtailment scenarios.
  • Demonstrate explicitly how the pipeline design basis supports downstream commitments: engine fleet demand and turndown, campus availability requirements, and the nominations-versus-consumption balance that governs system pressure.
  • Evaluate gas storage and supply resilience options, including line pack utilization, interconnect diversity, and cross-connection strategies between lines, with clear analysis of the risk each option carries.

Process and controls engineering

  • Own the overpressure protection philosophy across the pipeline systems: regulation, monitor, slam-shut, and relief selection, justified against reliability requirements, industry practice, and regulatory obligations rather than habit.
  • Define the control philosophy at interconnects, letdown stations, and plant interfaces: pressure versus flow control, control interactions with upstream operators' facilities, and the measurement and SCADA provisions needed to run the system on inventory.
  • Apply process safety discipline to the pipeline scope: lead and support HAZOPs and design reviews, own the closure of actions, and carry management of change through design and construction.
  • Engineer the interface into the plant fuel gas systems, coordinating conditioning, letdown, and protection philosophies so pipeline and plant behave as one system.

Regulatory compliance and integrity

  • Own compliance of the pipeline designs with 49 CFR Part 192 and the applicable ASME B31 codes, including the code boundaries between jurisdictional pipeline and plant piping.
  • Establish material, welding, and construction specifications, class location and MAOP documentation, and the records discipline that a traceable, verifiable, and complete basis requires.
  • Lay the foundation for integrity management: baseline assessment planning, pigging and inspection provisions, and mainline valve philosophy, including remote actuation and its treatment in availability analysis.
  • Support commissioning and first gas: purge and pack planning, energization of the measurement and control systems, and readiness reviews in partnership with the commissioning and startup organization.

Third-party technical management

  • Technically manage the engineering consultants supporting the pipeline scope: set the design basis they work to, review and challenge their deliverables, and integrate their output into a coherent whole.
  • Direct pipeline construction contractors on technical matters: specification compliance, field queries, deviation dispositions, and as-built reconciliation.
  • Own the technical interface with upstream pipeline operators and interconnect counterparties: metering station design, control coordination, nominations behavior, and the operating agreements' technical exhibits.
  • Hold third parties to disciplined engineering, testing, and documentation, and know when their standard answer is not good enough for this application.

Standards and cross-functional leadership

  • Develop Nscale's engineering standards, specifications, and reference designs for gas pipelines, so each new line builds on the last instead of starting over.
  • Coordinate with generation engineering on fuel gas requirements, with permitting and land teams on routing and regulatory strategy, and with commercial teams on gas supply and transportation arrangements.
  • Grow the internal pipeline engineering capability over time, directing specialist consultants today and building a small team as the portfolio scales.
  • Communicate complex pipeline and process issues clearly to project leadership and executives, with honest assessments of risk and readiness.

About You

  • 12+ years of natural gas pipeline engineering experience across design, construction, and operations, with significant time in a lead or owner's engineer role on transmission systems.
  • Deep hydraulic engineering capability, including transient modeling of gas transmission systems, and the judgment to translate model results into design and operating decisions.
  • Strong process engineering instincts: comfort with inventory-based system behavior, regulation and overpressure protection design, control philosophy development, and process safety methods such as HAZOP.
  • Working fluency with 49 CFR Part 192 and ASME B31.8, including MAOP determination, class location, and the code interfaces with plant piping under B31.1 or B31.3.
  • Hands-on experience with measurement and regulation stations, interconnects with major interstate pipelines, and the commercial mechanics of nominations and transportation that drive system behavior.
  • Experience taking pipeline scopes through construction, hydrotest, and first gas on major projects, and comfort in the field when systems misbehave.
  • Proven ability to direct engineering consultants and construction contractors, and to make technically defensible decisions under schedule pressure.
  • Demonstrated ability to run a scope with minimal oversight: establishing the basis, setting the pace, and escalating with solutions rather than problems.
  • Proven ability to build standards, processes, and small teams in a fast-scaling environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Civil Engineering or a related field; PE license preferred.
  • Willing and able to travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and construction spreads regularly (typically 25%, higher during construction and commissioning campaigns).

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and our people are driving it.

  • Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • A career-defining opportunity to be an early member of one of the fastest growing AI infrastructure companies in the world
  • A human-first approach: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy needed to get the job done.

The Chief of Staff serves as a strategic advisor and force multiplier to the Head of Distribution, shaping the leadership processes through which executive leaders align on strategy, priorities, business performance, and enterprise decisions. The role creates organizational leverage by connecting priorities across functions, anticipating risks and dependencies, improving decision quality, and ensuring leaders have the insights and alignment needed to drive business outcomes. The Head of Distribution and functional executives retain accountability for strategic choices, resource decisions, operational execution, and business results. Acting as a strategic extension of the Head of Distribution, this role synthesizes information, frames complex issues anticipates and surfaces risks and opportunities, facilitates alignment, and ensures executive commitments receive appropriate follow-through and enables effective executive decision-making across a highly matrixed organization.


The Chief of Staff does not assume accountability for business results, functional execution, project delivery, or organizational decision rights. Functional leaders remain accountable for strategy execution and outcomes. The Chief of Staff creates value through strategic insight, organizational alignment, executive decision support, and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:


Executive partnership and leadership effectiveness: Serve as a trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution; anticipate leadership needs, prepare executive briefings and decision materials, coordinate sensitive cross-functional matters, and facilitate follow-through on executive commitments and help focus leadership attention on the highest value opportunities, risks, and decisions.


Strategic planning process: Design and facilitate the annual and ongoing strategic planning process. Coordinate inputs from executive leaders, structure planning discussions, document strategic choices, and integrate functional plans into a coherent Distribution agenda while leaders retain ownership of strategy and execution.


Executive governance and operating cadence: Establish and manage leadership meetings, business reviews, planning forums, agendas, decision logs, escalation paths, and accountability tracking that enable organizational alignment, transparency, and effective execution. Coordinate executive committee, CEO, and Board materials as requested.

Cross-functional alignment: Facilitate coordination across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement, as well as Finance, Product, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, Technology, and other enterprise partners by connecting priorities, resolving ambiguity, identifying dependencies, and ensuring critical decisions and information flow effectively across organizational boundaries.


Performance insights and decision support: Coordinate executive scorecards and business performance reviews; synthesize financial, operational, customer, and distribution information; identify trends, emerging risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and strategic implications requiring leadership attention.


Strategic portfolio visibility: Maintains an integrated view of major initiatives, strategic priorities, critical dependencies, organizational friction points, and emerging risks. Proactively identify potential collisions, surface issues early, and facilitate executive dialogue to enable timely decisions and course correction.


Executive communication: Support consistent communication of Distribution priorities and leadership decisions across functions and enterprise stakeholders; prepare executive narratives, updates, and presentations.


Organizational effectiveness: Creates organizational leverage for the Head of Distribution by connecting priorities, aligning stakeholders, reducing complexity, accelerating decision-making, and ensuring leadership attention remains focused on the issues most critical to business performance and growth.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (Early Career)

Location: Canada (Remote or Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Build technology that solves real business problems.

At Hiveway, we believe software should make work simpler—not more complicated.

We build payment and revenue automation solutions that help organizations modernize how they collect payments, connect business systems, and eliminate manual processes.

We're looking for curious, ambitious engineers at the beginning of their careers who want more than a traditional software development role.

If you're excited by solving real customer problems, building production software, and learning directly from experienced engineers while working with enterprise customers, we'd love to meet you.

What is a Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer?

A Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE) combines software engineering, solution architecture, and customer problem-solving into one role.

Instead of working only from a product backlog, you'll work alongside customers to understand how their business operates, identify technical challenges, and help build solutions that create measurable business impact.

You'll learn how software, payments, APIs, data, finance, and business operations come together to solve real-world problems.

No two projects are exactly the same—which means you'll constantly learn, grow, and be challenged.

What You'll Do

Working alongside experienced engineers and mentors, you'll help:

  • Build production software and customer solutions
  • Design and develop API integrations
  • Connect payment, CRM, ERP, and accounting systems
  • Automate manual business processes
  • Design data workflows and reconciliation logic
  • Investigate and resolve production issues
  • Participate in customer discovery sessions
  • Translate business challenges into technical solutions
  • Improve existing platform capabilities
  • Document and share technical best practices

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and directly with customers.

What You'll Learn

This role is designed to accelerate your career.

During your first year you'll gain experience in:

  • Software engineering best practices
  • Solution architecture
  • API design and integrations
  • Payment technologies
  • Cloud applications
  • Production operations
  • Customer discovery
  • Enterprise software implementation
  • Systems thinking
  • Technical communication

You'll receive mentorship while taking on meaningful responsibility from day one.

What We're Looking For

You don't need to know everything.

We're looking for people with strong fundamentals and an eagerness to learn.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Love solving difficult problems
  • Enjoy learning new technologies
  • Ask thoughtful questions
  • Communicate clearly
  • Take ownership of your work
  • Like understanding how businesses operate
  • Enjoy collaborating with both technical and non-technical people
  • Are curious about APIs, integrations, automation, or cloud software
  • Want to see your work used by real customers

Minimum Qualifications

We're interested in candidates who are completing or have recently completed a degree or diploma in areas such as:

  • Computer Science
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mathematics
  • Data Science
  • Information Systems
  • Physics
  • Mechatronics

Equivalent technical experience is also welcome.

You should also have:

  • Experience programming in at least one modern language
  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals
  • Familiarity with Git
  • Basic understanding of APIs, databases, or web applications
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills

Programming languages may include:

  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Python
  • Java
  • C#
  • Go
  • C++
  • Or another modern language

Bonus Points

We're especially interested if you've:

  • Completed internships or co-op placements
  • Built applications people actually use
  • Created personal or open-source projects
  • Participated in hackathons
  • Worked with APIs
  • Built full-stack applications
  • Worked at a startup
  • Automated repetitive work
  • Built something outside the classroom

We care much more about what you've built than where you've built it.

How We Work

At Hiveway we believe:

Start with the problem.

Understand the customer before designing the solution.

Build for production.

Reliable software beats clever software.

Stay curious.

The best engineers are always learning.

Own outcomes.

We take responsibility for solving problems—not just completing tasks.

Keep improving.

Every customer teaches us something that makes our platform better.

Your First 90 Days

You'll receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and regular feedback.

During your first three months you'll:

  • Learn Hiveway's platform and development environment
  • Shadow customer meetings
  • Contribute production code
  • Build your first integration or workflow
  • Participate in architecture discussions
  • Learn our engineering standards
  • Work with experienced engineers on customer implementations

As your confidence grows, so will your ownership.

What Success Looks Like

Successful engineers at Hiveway:

  • Ask great questions
  • Learn quickly
  • Build reliable software
  • Communicate effectively
  • Solve customer problems
  • Take ownership
  • Continuously improve
  • Help others succeed

Why Join Hiveway?

Large companies often give new graduates a very small piece of a very large system.

At Hiveway, you'll see the entire picture.

You'll learn directly from experienced engineers, work with enterprise customers, contribute to production systems, and influence how our platform evolves.

You'll gain experience across engineering, product, customer solutions, and business operations while helping solve meaningful problems for growing organizations.

If you want a role where your work matters from the beginning, Hiveway is the place to build your career.

Compensation & Benefits

Expected base salary:

CAD $85,000 – $105,000

Actual compensation will depend on your experience, internships, technical skills, and demonstrated capabilities.

Our total rewards package may include:

  • Performance-based incentives
  • Equity participation
  • Health and dental benefits
  • Paid vacation
  • Professional development budget
  • Home office and technology support
  • Mentorship and career development
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume (PDF preferred)
  • GitHub, portfolio, or personal website (if available)

We don't expect you to know everything.

We're interested in what you've built, what you've learned, and how you approach solving difficult problems.

Equal Opportunity

Hiveway is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are evaluated based on their skills, potential, curiosity, and ability to contribute.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

If you're excited about building great software, solving real customer problems, and growing alongside an experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary: 80-110k

jobs.description:
Senior QA Engineer

Full-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity. Our work is guided by a culture of innovation, creativity and close collaboration, allowing us to pursue our vision of bringing back the fun in video games and creating experiences that feel engaging, rewarding and memorable for players. We operate as a fully remote studio with a globally distributed team of experienced developers, artists and designers. Prism is structured around trust, accountability and clear communication, enabling us to collaborate efficiently across time zones while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and execution.

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.
  • Create detailed test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical and gameplay requirements.
  • Test new features and systems across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility scenarios.
  • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and relevant technical information.
  • Work directly with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to investigate issues, determine severity, and validate fixes.
  • Test gameplay systems within Unreal Engine 5, using your technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behaviour.
  • Support testing of multiplayer and networked gameplay, identifying issues relating to replication, connectivity, latency, synchronisation, and player interactions.
  • Coordinate and support internal playtests, turning observations and player feedback into clear, actionable findings.
  • Maintain bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and reporting within Jira.
  • Monitor defect trends and testing data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring additional test coverage.
  • Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.
  • Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.
  • Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

  • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality role.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with proven commercial experience on a shipped title or game currently in active production.
  • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the relationship between engineering, design, art, production, and QA.
  • Experience creating and maintaining structured test plans, test cases, and regression coverage.
  • Strong bug investigation and reproduction skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and precisely.
  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant scripting or programming technologies, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.
  • Experience with QA and bug-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration/delivery workflows.
  • Experience analysing QA data, defect trends, and testing results to identify patterns and areas of risk.
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and discussing issues directly with engineers.
  • Highly organised and capable of independently managing priorities across multiple features and areas of development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A proactive approach to quality, with the ability to identify potential issues before they become larger production problems.
  • Genuine interest in games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay feel polished, responsive, and enjoyable.
  • Must be based in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in daily collaboration, meetings, and team syncs.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience testing multiplayer, PvP, PvE, or shooter titles.
  • Experience testing networked gameplay and debugging issues involving replication, latency, matchmaking, or online services.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, scripts, or QA tools.
  • Experience with performance, load, or stress testing.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated build validation.
  • Experience testing across multiple platforms.
  • AAA game development experience.
  • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.
  • Experience contributing to a title through multiple stages of production, from early development through launch.
  • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer games.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplinary team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Technical 3D Character Artist who specialize in character pipelines and animations, with a cartoonist’s comedic timing and a systems-first mindset.

You will architect our character pipeline from the ground up. You will build a scalable, modular character system: designing plug-and-play facial features, swappable clothing kits, and a unified rig that lets code drive endless distinct NPCs. Your characters must prioritize bold silhouettes and comedic physicality, extreme emotional states, physical impairment, and chaotic meltdowns instantly readable in first person.

Key Responsibilities

Job Description Summary

‎

Mosaic Health is seeking a hands-on engineer with strong applied AI experience and deep knowledge of technology infrastructure and data pipelines. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a people-management position. You will build applications, integrations and automated workflows across apree, CareMore and Millennium Physician Group. Your work will connect operational needs with dependable technical solutions that improve service, reduce manual effort and support the business.

You will take initiative and personally carry solutions from discovery through rapid prototyping, pilot deployment and value validation, then partner with IT, data and security teams to industrialize solutions approved to scale. You will spend a substantial portion of your time designing, writing, testing and troubleshooting code, including the data pipelines that support your applications. Success requires independent execution and close collaboration: you will seek input early, work constructively with operational, IT, data and security partners, and keep stakeholders informed.
You will focus on a prioritized set of initiatives, understand differences in workflows and systems across the businesses, and build reusable capabilities that can be adapted to local needs.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Work with operational teams to understand workflows, handoffs, exceptions and sources of data. Turn an agreed business objective into a practical technical plan, identify missing information, and drive the next steps without waiting for fully specified requirements.
  • Build, collaborate on, and maintain AI-enabled applications, backend services and integrations. Apply language models, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling where they solve a defined operational problem.
  • Design and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating and delivering structured and unstructured data. Handle data quality, schema changes, retries, duplicate records and backfills, and make data lineage and failures traceable.
  • Prototype and evaluate models, frameworks and software tools. Compare AI-based approaches with conventional software and existing products, and recommend solutions based on measured quality, latency, cost, maintainability and operational fit.
  • Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for model outputs, retrieval quality and complete workflows.
  • Partner with IT, data and security teams across Mosaic Health on approved architecture, access, integrations and deployment. Build pilots within approved environments and, for solutions approved to scale, work with Technology to transition and industrialize them with appropriate identity and access controls, networking, secrets management, auditability and protection of sensitive information.
  • Collaborate with consultants and vendors while retaining hands-on ownership of your deliverables. Review designs and code, contribute directly to implementation, and ensure documentation and knowledge transfer allow you to maintain and extend the work.
  • Work with business owners and Finance partners on pilot rollout, user feedback and value validation. Establish the baseline and track adoption, cycle time, manual effort, error rates, and realized operational and financial value to determine whether the solution should scale.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Typically, 5-7 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience building and deploying AI-enabled applications. Demonstrated ownership of production systems and the ability to explain technical decisions, failures and improvements.
  • Evidence of personally taking a product or workflow from an initial idea through pilot deployment and value validation, with demonstrated ability to partner on industrialization and ongoing improvement, including integrating language models into real applications. Able to explain what you built, how you resolved obstacles, and how you supported the solution after launch.
  • Strong backend development skills in Python and/or TypeScript, proficiency in SQL, and experience designing APIs, services and database schemas.
  • Practical understanding of language model APIs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling. Able to design workflows around model limitations and select the appropriate approach for the task.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems with representative datasets and measurable quality criteria, including retrieval accuracy, unsupported outputs, edge cases and regression testing. Able to balance quality, latency and cost.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed applications, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, containers, queues, observability and CI/CD. Experience diagnosing production issues and making reliability, security and cost tradeoffs.
  • A record of taking initiative and delivering with limited day-to-day direction. Able to break ambiguous problems into manageable steps, make sound technical decisions, learn unfamiliar tools, and follow through on implementation and support. Recognizes when to seek input or escalate a dependency, bringing clear options and a recommended next step.
  • A collaborative working style: listens to frontline users, seeks and incorporates feedback, shares knowledge, and works respectfully across disciplines. Communicates progress and tradeoffs clearly, follows through on commitments, and helps partners resolve shared problems.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data pipelines, including ETL/ELT, batch and event-driven processing, orchestration, data validation and monitoring. Understands how source-system behavior, data freshness, lineage and schema changes affect downstream applications and AI outputs.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
