jobs.description:
About the Role

Engageware powers appointment scheduling for some of the largest banks, credit unions, healthcare systems, and retailers in the world — on the order of a million appointments and interactions a day. When someone books time with their bank or schedules a visit with their care team, our platform finds the right availability, the right person, and the right place, and makes it effortless: online, in the branch, at the kiosk, in the walk-in queue, or virtually, with reminders and routing handled end to end.

We're looking for a hands-on Team Lead to own how the Appointment Scheduling team runs — the process, planning, and delivery — and to drive its technical direction. You'll grow the engineers around you, keep the team healthy and shipping, and carry our platform into the AI age: an AI-augmented development lifecycle where agents do real work across design, code, test, and review, and a product where booking is conversational, availability is intelligent, and every answer is grounded in real, verified data.

What You'll Do

Team & Delivery Leadership

  • Own the team's planning, prioritization, and delivery — the process and the day-to-day execution — ensuring the Appointment Scheduling team ships reliably at enterprise scale.
  • Grow and coach engineers at all levels (including senior and principal ICs); keep the team engaged, healthy, and improving.
  • Partner closely with the Principal Engineer to translate the hardest architectural decisions into reliable, shipped product.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design so that what ships solves the customer's actual problem, not just the technical one.

Technical Direction

  • Own the overall technical direction for your area of the scheduling platform: the availability and booking engine, routing and reminders, and the online/branch/kiosk/queue/virtual channel experiences built on top.
  • Make the mature, business-critical scheduling core safer and faster to change — through pragmatic modernization, improved test coverage, and cleaner API surfaces — without big-bang rewrites.
  • Shape and evolve the platform's data architecture (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and service boundaries (Spring Boot, Scala/Akka) to support scale and AI extensibility.
  • Maintain Engageware's reliability bar: the scheduling platform cannot let a customer down.

AI-Augmented Development Lifecycle

  • Lead the team's adoption of an AI-augmented SDLC — putting AI agents (built on Claude) to work across design, code generation, test authoring, code review, and legacy modernization.
  • Set the team's norms and guardrails for AI-assisted development, with a strong test and CI/CD backbone ensuring AI-generated changes ship fast and safely.
  • Stay current on agentic development patterns (including MCP-based tooling) and raise the team's fluency over time.

AI in the Product

  • Bring intelligent capabilities into the Appointment Scheduling product where they earn their place: conversational and assisted booking, smarter availability recommendations, reduced no-show rates, and proactive engagement.
  • Ensure all AI-driven features are grounded in real, verified availability data — never hallucinated — and are evaluated honestly against clear success metrics.
  • Partner with the Principal PM to align AI product bets with customer value and the broader scheduling roadmap.

What We're Looking For

Must-have qualifications:

  • A track record of leading an engineering team to deliver: owning process, planning, and outcomes, while staying technically hands-on. You've shipped product, not just run a team.
  • Depth in the Appointment Scheduling tech stack: JVM backend (Java / Spring Boot, Java 17) and modern TypeScript front ends (React and/or Angular), with comfort in high-throughput services and the relational data behind them.
  • Experience modernizing large, mature, business-critical systems — making them safer and faster to change without disrupting the business.
  • Fluency with AI coding agents and AI-augmented development; ideally you've helped a team adopt AI across the SDLC, and you've shipped real LLM/AI features into production with clear-eyed judgment about where AI helps and where it doesn't.
  • Genuine product sense: you care about the booking experience the customer feels, not only the architecture behind it.
  • Based in the United States, with willingness to travel occasionally for team and customer meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with scheduling, calendaring, availability modeling, or resource-optimization problems.
  • SQL and relational data depth; API design and integration experience at enterprise scale.
  • Background in financial services, banking, credit unions, healthcare, or retail technology.
  • Experience exposing platform capabilities to AI agents via MCP or similar patterns.

Our Stack

Knowing our stack is not a requirement, but this is what you'll be working with:

  • Backend: Mature Java scheduling engine; Spring Boot (Java 17) services; Scala/Akka services
  • Frontend: Modern Angular and React applications
  • Data: SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS
  • AI: Claude models (Anthropic), with MCP-based agent tooling

Become a part of our caring community

Humana’s Digital Health Platform (DHP) is the engineering platform behind many of Humana’s consumer digital experiences. DHP Product Engineering builds the shared pieces other Humana teams build on, including a micro-frontend catalog, accessibility tooling, and API foundations, and we build them with AI coding agents at the center of how we work. We are hiring a Senior Product Engineer, Accessibility, to own the products that help Humana’s teams build accessible web and mobile experiences from the start.
We run accessibility as products with customers. Product teams across Humana are the customers, and our members and patients benefit. You set the direction for products such as automated accessibility testing in pipelines, an accessibility linter, an accessibility health dashboard, and AI agent skills, and you build them alongside our product engineers. You also run parts of Humana’s Digital Accessibility Program, and we expect you to automate more of that work over time.

How we work: Our practice is skills-driven. A skill is a set of reusable instructions that an AI agent follows for a recurring task. The accessibility program already runs on skills. You will use them, write new ones, and ship accessibility skills that other teams use in their own work.


We welcome candidates with disabilities, including people who use assistive technology every day. That experience is directly relevant to this role. We support IAAP certification if you do not hold one yet.


Role Responsibilities

  • Set product direction: Set the direction for our accessibility products, propose what goes on their roadmap, and write the stories
  • Build accessibility products: Build and maintain automated accessibility tests, scan rules, CI integrations, and AI agent skills, and run spikes and prototypes before investing in a full implementation
  • Own the toolchain: Roll out, configure, and integrate our commercial accessibility testing tools, so that product teams can adopt them with little effort
  • Measure adoption and outcomes: Track measures such as the share of product teams with accessibility checks in their pipelines and the time to close critical findings, and bring the results into roadmap decisions
  • Enable product teams: Bring accessibility checks into teams’ editors, pipelines, and agent workflows, own our developer checklists, give specific remediation guidance, and run training and office hours
  • Test with assistive technology: Test web and mobile experiences with screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, magnification, and voice control
  • Run the program: Keep the Digital Accessibility Policy, Standards, and Conformance Statement current, coordinate audits with our audit vendor, provide technical evidence to Humana’s legal partners for compliance reviews and complaint responses, and handle vendor administration
  • Review software Humana buys: Help Humana’s Procurement organization assess consumer-facing software, including software evaluations, contract negotiations, and review of each vendor’s Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT)

What helps you succeed here:

  • Influencing engineers and teams that do not report to you, through clear guidance, examples, and follow-through
  • Writing clearly for engineers, legal partners, and senior leaders, and adjusting the level of detail for each
  • Keeping many requests moving at once, and saying early and plainly when one will be late
  • Bringing structure to ambiguous problems and to processes that are still taking shape


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field
  • 5 or more years designing, developing, and testing software, including 3 or more years focused on digital accessibility and testing with screen readers such as NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack
  • 2 or more years building or rolling out accessibility capabilities that teams beyond your own adopted, such as checks in their pipelines
  • 2 or more years building automated accessibility tests in JavaScript or TypeScript with Playwright or similar tools, and running them in CI/CD pipelines
  • Working knowledge of Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 504, and Section 508

Preferred Qualifications

  • Owning a product’s roadmap and tying the work to measured results
  • Building AI agent skills, prompts, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
  • Running third-party accessibility audits, including scoping, findings triage, retesting, and Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) production

  • International Association of Accessibility Professionals (IAAP) certification (CPACC, WAS, or CPWA)

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. Our product, VyOS, is an enterprise-grade networking platform for consistent operations and automation at scale, delivering full control and high performance with zero vendor lock-in. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.

Job description

The Business Development Representative generates new sales opportunities for VyOS through outbound prospecting. The job is to find the right companies and people in the assigned territory, reach them with personalised outreach, qualify their interest and book meetings for the sales team.

  • Build target account and contact lists in the assigned territory that match the VyOS ideal customer profile: network and infrastructure teams at service providers, cloud and hosting providers, MSPs and enterprises.
  • Run outbound outreach every day: cold calls, personalised email sequences and LinkedIn messages.
  • Qualify prospects against the ideal customer profile: company fit, use case, timing, and whether the contact is the decision maker or a technical influencer.
  • Book discovery meetings for the account executive or the CRO, confirm attendance, and join the first call to hand over context.
  • Follow up with prospects who showed interest but are not ready yet, and keep them warm until they are.
  • Turn signals passed on by marketing (website visitors, LinkedIn profile viewers, event contacts) into outbound sequences.
  • Keep HubSpot CRM accurate: every contact, touch, meeting and outcome logged the same day; sequences run in Apollo.

How success is measured

  • Qualified meetings booked and held per month.
  • Outbound activity volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting quality, as accepted by the account executive.

Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years in an outbound SDR or BDR role in B2B technology, with a track record of hitting meeting targets.
  • Or a technical background looking to move into sales: an engineering degree or training in networking or systems administration, or hands-on experience as a network engineer, sysadmin or DevOps engineer. If you can talk to a network team in their own language and want to learn outbound sales, we will teach you the sales part.
  • Experience selling to network, infrastructure or IT teams, or into service providers, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with open-source software and Linux is a plus.

Skills

  • Comfortable with cold calling and with writing short, personalised outreach. Persistent, not put off by rejection.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English.
  • Organised and disciplined with daily activity, follow-ups and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to research an account quickly and find the right contact.
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot and a sales engagement tool such as Apollo. LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.
  • Enough networking understanding to hold a first conversation (routing, firewalls, VPN, cloud networking), or the drive to learn it fast.

About VyOS

VyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. Network engineers manage VyOS through a single CLI with commit and rollback, or through the API and standard automation tools.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Stealth Startup

We're launching a new startup that is redefining how mission-critical organizations adopt AI. Our platform helps organizations across healthcare, government, and other regulated industries transform institutional knowledge into intelligence assets that improve the accuracy, reliability, and impact of AI in real-world workflows. We're a fast-moving team of builders, researchers, and operators working to help customers create, measure, and continuously improve AI capabilities they can own and control.

About the Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff, AI Researcher to help turn complex, real-world workflows into the evaluation frameworks, reinforcement learning environments, and feedback systems needed to advance frontier AI.

This is a blended research and engineering role for someone who operates at the intersection of scientific inquiry and technical execution. You will investigate how data, evaluations, and feedback systems influence model behavior, while building the infrastructure and tools required to test and apply those ideas.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and methodologies for frontier large language models, AI agents, multimodal models, and reinforcement learning environments
  • Develop reward models, programmatic verifiers, graders, and other feedback systems that make model behavior measurable and improvable
  • Design and run controlled supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning experiments to measure the effects of datasets on model capability, generalization, and alignment
  • Research and define what makes evaluations representative of real-world work and operational environments
  • Build systems for producing high-quality human data, including expert task design, annotation methodologies, data-quality signals, and data-attribution techniques
  • Translate research questions into lightweight, rigorous experiments that generate actionable findings
  • Prototype quickly, evaluate results, diagnose failure modes, and convert findings into improved benchmarks, datasets, or technical systems
  • Move promising methods from experimentation into scalable, production-quality implementations
  • Work across research, engineering, product, and operations to advance a shared technical roadmap
  • Contribute to the broader technical community through benchmarks, open-source tools, research, and technical writing

This Role is a Great Fit if You:

  • Are equally comfortable investigating an open-ended research question and building the system needed to test it
  • Approach AI research with a builder mindset and focus on producing measurable, usable outcomes
  • Are deeply interested in how data structure, selection, attribution, and quality affect model behavior
  • Can design focused experiments, interpret imperfect or ambiguous results, and translate findings into technical decisions
  • Are eager to move quickly without sacrificing rigor, maintainability, or engineering quality
  • Are comfortable working across unfamiliar domains and converting real-world workflows into measurable tasks
  • Demonstrate high agency, sound technical judgment, and a strong sense of ownership
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders
  • Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical approaches may evolve
  • Are motivated by the purpose and real-world impact of the work, not simply by access to emerging technologies

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, data science, software engineering, or a related technical field
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of AI research and software engineering
  • Strong Python skills and experience building reliable, scalable software
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, model evaluations, reinforcement learning, post-training, or related systems
  • Strong understanding of frontier AI methods, including benchmarks, evaluation techniques, agent harnesses, post-training approaches, and training-data design
  • Experience building or working with reward models, automated verifiers, graders, or other model-feedback systems
  • Experience designing evaluations or experiments that measure model capability, generalization, alignment, or agent performance
  • Ability to build research prototypes and develop them into maintainable, production-quality systems
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and technical documentation skills
  • U.S. citizenship is required

An advanced degree in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, data science, or a related field is preferred but not required. Candidates with equivalent research and engineering experience, including strong technical, open-source, or published output, are encouraged to apply.

Salary Range: $250,000-400,000 + equity. This represents the typical base salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs’ financial needs are met without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms across Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can leverage, starting with revenue-based financing. We are a high-performing, close-knit team with talent from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan.

We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling operations across multiple markets. As part of this growth journey, eligible team members have the opportunity to participate in R2’s Phantom Share Program, a performance-based incentive designed to align our team with the company’s long-term success and value creation. We believe in building a culture of ownership, where those who help create value share meaningfully in it.

R2 is scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Portfolio Manager (IC4) to own the credit portfolio: someone who builds a genuinely quantitative relationship with the business, tracks portfolio performance end-to-end, and can evaluate high-ticket merchant credit. We need someone who deeply understands portfolio economics, can pull and structure the data themselves, and knows how to read a portfolio and turn it into decisions. Mitigate risks and detect patterns in larger datasets.

What You'll Do

  • Own monitoring the credit portfolio: vintages, losses, originations, NPL by cohort, and profitability.
  • Evaluate and underwrite high-ticket merchant credit facilities (tickets of USD 100K–200K and above), at scale- not one loan at a time.
  • Define and track business metrics: loss, yield/profitability, portfolio construction and health.
  • Work hands-on in SQL to extract, structure, and analyze portfolio data independently.
  • Apply statistical reasoning to portfolio questions.
  • Partner closely with the business team and handle a degree of client interaction.
  • Generate findings and transform them into presentations for a larger audience
  • Automate monitoring KPIs of this portfolio

Who You Are

  • ~7 years of experience in credit, lending, credit risk, business analytics, or lending institution
  • Background in a fintech, payment processor, POS provider, or bank, credit risk — real lending/credit exposure is essential.
  • Hands-on underwriting experience, ideally with large/high-ticket merchant credit, and the ability to work at scale (mass evaluation, not manual case-by-case).
  • Strong data analysis SQL and or Python — this is the core technical requirement.
  • Statistical / data literacy — you don't need to build models, but you should be comfortable with the fundamentals of statistics and data analysis and model interpretation.
  • Comfort using AI tools is a plus. What matters most is that you know the material — whether you get there with or without AI is up to you.
  • Cultural fit: we move fast. We want someone who thrives in a dynamic, startup-style environment. Prior experience working with US or LatAm teams (across time zones and cultures) is a strong plus.

Bonus

  • Corporate / B2B cards count. Cards are a credit product; someone who has underwritten corporate cards with high limits (e.g., USD 1M+) has relevant experience.
  • Traditional/corporate backgrounds (including large banks) are welcome, provided the credit/lending experience and cultural fit are there.

What We Offer

  • The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech.
  • Ownership and impact in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams.
